# Основные файлы для разбора другим ИИ

В этом компактном наборе: действующая очередь, интерфейс статуса, исполнители Fluent, контроль сходимости, подготовка геометрии/сетки, код гладкой трубы/моделей и актуальные планы. Подтянуты локальные Python-зависимости выбранных программ.
Тяжёлых case/data/сеток и полных transcript здесь нет. Это комплект для изучения кода; для запуска CFD нужны исходные данные и установленный ANSYS на рабочем ПК.

Читать по порядку:
1. runs/queue/jobs.json — актуальная очередь на момент снимка.
2. dataset/knurl_dataset_resume_1104_v2.py — действующее продолжение после MPI-сбоя; исходная логика в knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1.py и knurl_dataset_dispatch_1104_v1.py.
3. dataset/queue_runner.py и jobqueue.py — планировщик.
4. dataset/author_gui_live_1104_v3.py — текущий статус; предыдущие v1/v2 включены как зависимости.
5. dataset/cont_util.py, gui_runner.py, gui_convergence.py, leontiev_pipeline.py, single_writer_d12a_1103_v1.py — расчёт и критерии.
6. dataset/build_knurl_case_1104_v10.py и native-макросы — сборка Fluent и сетка.
7. dataset/run_dataset.py, run_a9.py, surrogate.py, fast1d*.py, model_compare.py, heldout_check.py; program/sppr.py — гладкая труба, модели и пользовательская программа.
8. КОНТЕКСТ_проекта_20261029.md, Журнал_работ.md и runs/plans — решения и зарегистрированные настройки.

Исходные файлы не изменялись. Зарегистрированные планы ссылаются также на тяжёлые данные из полного проекта; компактный архив не заменяет эти данные. Старые/вспомогательные версии включены только там, где нужны для чтения зависимостей и понимания истории. Не запускать копию очереди параллельно действующей.




========================================================================
ФАЙЛ: apply_geometry_and_mesh_row.wbjn
========================================================================
# Open F:\Leontiev_Project\g_08_1.wbpj in Workbench 2024 R2 first.
# Builds geometry and mesh for ONE selected CSV row. No Fluent solve.
TABLE_PATH = r'F:\Leontiev_Project\project_inputs.csv'
ROW_INDEX = 0
ROOT = r'F:\Leontiev_Project'
import csv,math,json,time,uuid
RUN_TOKEN=str(uuid.uuid4())
def stage(name):
    with open(ROOT+r'\mesh_workflow_progress.json','w') as f:
        json.dump({'row':ROW_INDEX,'stage':name,'time':time.time(),'run_token':RUN_TOKEN},f)
stage('reading_table')
with open(TABLE_PATH,'rb') as f:
    reader=csv.DictReader(f)
    reader.fieldnames=[s.lstrip('\xef\xbb\xbf') for s in reader.fieldnames]
    rows=list(reader)
row=rows[ROW_INDEX]
mesh_mode=row.get('mesh_mode','series').strip().lower()
if mesh_mode not in ('series','control'):raise ValueError('mesh_mode must be series or control')
mesh_size_mm={'series':0.75,'control':0.25}[mesh_mode]
parameters=dict((str(p.DisplayText),p) for p in Parameters.GetAllParameters())
CFD_COLUMNS=set(('secondary_inlet_mode','p0_inlet_svz_MPa','p_outlet_svz_MPa','p0_inlet_dzv_MPa','p_outlet_dzv_MPa','mass_flow_inlet_dzv_kg_s','T0_inlet_svz_K','T0_inlet_dzv_K','gas_material','gas_model','wall_material','turbulent_prandtl','first_layer_height_um'))
first_layer_height_um=float(row.get('first_layer_height_um',1.0))
if not 0.08<=first_layer_height_um<=1.0:raise ValueError('First layer height must be 0.08 to 1 um')
with open(ROOT+r'\mesh_run_config.json','w') as f:
    json.dump({'first_layer_height_um':first_layer_height_um,'run_token':RUN_TOKEN},f)
values={'GEO_first_layer_height':first_layer_height_um/1000.0}
for key,value in row.items():
    if key in ('case_id','mesh_mode'):continue
    name='GEO_'+key[:-3] if key.endswith('_mm') else None
    if key in CFD_COLUMNS:continue
    if name not in parameters:raise ValueError('Unknown geometry column: '+key)
    number=float(value)
    if math.isnan(number) or math.isinf(number):raise ValueError('Non-finite dimension '+key)
    values[name]=number
if set(values)!=set(n for n in parameters if n.startswith('GEO_')):
    raise ValueError('CSV must contain every geometry parameter')
system1=GetSystem(Name='SYS 1')
dp=Parameters.GetBaseDesignPoint()
mesh=system1.GetContainer(ComponentName='Mesh')
stage('closing_mesh_before_geometry')
mesh.Exit(SaveDatabase=True)
for name,value in values.items():
    dp.SetParameterExpression(Parameter=parameters[name],Expression=repr(value)+' [mm]')
stage('geometry_update')
system1.GetComponent(Name='Geometry').Update(AllDependencies=True)
stage('mesh_refresh')
system1.GetComponent(Name='Mesh').Refresh()
mesh.Edit()
mesh.SendCommand(Language='Python',Command="MESH_RUN_TOKEN="+repr(RUN_TOKEN)+";"+"MESH_MODE="+repr(mesh_mode)+"; execfile(r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_scope.py')")
scope=json.load(open(ROOT+r'\mesh_repair.json'))
if scope.get('run_token')!=RUN_TOKEN:raise RuntimeError('Stale mesh scoping result')
if scope.get('error'):raise RuntimeError(scope['error'])
stage('mesh_generation')
mesh.SendCommand(Language='Python',Command="MESH_RUN_TOKEN="+repr(RUN_TOKEN)+";"+"MESH_RESULT_PATH=r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_current_generated.json'; execfile(r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_generate.py')")
generated=json.load(open(ROOT+r'\mesh_current_generated.json'))
if generated.get('run_token')!=RUN_TOKEN:raise RuntimeError('Stale mesh generation result')
if generated.get('error') or not generated.get('generated'):
    raise RuntimeError(generated.get('error','Mesh generation not confirmed'))
if int(generated.get('Elements','0'))<=0:raise RuntimeError('Mesh has no elements')
stage('quality_and_export')
mesh.SendCommand(Language='Python',Command="MESH_RUN_TOKEN="+repr(RUN_TOKEN)+";"+"MESH_QUALITY_PATH=r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_current_quality.json'; MESH_EXPORT_PATH=r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_current.msh'; execfile(r'"+ROOT+r"\mesh_quality.py')")
quality=json.load(open(ROOT+r'\mesh_current_quality.json'))
if quality.get('run_token')!=RUN_TOKEN:raise RuntimeError('Stale quality result')
if not quality.get('exported'):raise RuntimeError(quality.get('export_error','Mesh export not confirmed'))
stage('saving_mesh')
mesh.Exit(SaveDatabase=True)
system1.GetComponent(Name='Mesh').Update(AllDependencies=True)
Save()
with open(ROOT+r'\last_mesh_row.json','w') as f:
    json.dump({'case_id':row['case_id'],'row_index':ROW_INDEX,'geometry_mm':values,'mesh_mode':mesh_mode,'mesh_size_mm':mesh_size_mm,'mesh':generated},f,indent=2)
stage('complete')
print('Geometry and mesh saved for row '+str(ROW_INDEX)+': '+row['case_id'])

# Run in an already opened g_08_1 Workbench project: File > Scripting > Run Script File.
# Geometry stage only. Select the zero-based CSV row here.
TABLE_PATH = r'F:\Leontiev_Project\geometry_inputs.csv'
ROW_INDEX = 0
import csv, math

with open(TABLE_PATH,'rb') as f:
    reader=csv.DictReader(f)
    reader.fieldnames=[s.lstrip('\xef\xbb\xbf') for s in reader.fieldnames]
    rows=list(reader)
row=rows[ROW_INDEX]
parameters=dict((str(p.DisplayText),p) for p in Parameters.GetAllParameters())
values={}
for key,value in row.items():
    if key=='case_id':continue
    name='GEO_'+key[:-3] if key.endswith('_mm') else None
    if name not in parameters:raise ValueError('Unknown geometry parameter: '+key)
    number=float(value)
    if math.isnan(number) or math.isinf(number):raise ValueError('Non-finite value: '+key)
    values[name]=number
expected=set(name for name in parameters if name.startswith('GEO_'))
if set(values)!=expected:raise ValueError('CSV must contain all geometry input columns')
dp=Parameters.GetBaseDesignPoint()
original=dict((name,parameters[name].Expression) for name in values)
component=GetSystem(Name='SYS 1').GetComponent(Name='Geometry')
try:
    for name,value in values.items():
        dp.SetParameterExpression(Parameter=parameters[name],Expression=repr(value)+' [mm]')
    component.Update(AllDependencies=True)
    Save()
except:
    for name,expression in original.items():dp.SetParameterExpression(Parameter=parameters[name],Expression=expression)
    component.Update(AllDependencies=True)
    raise
print('Geometry updated for CSV row '+str(ROW_INDEX)+': '+row['case_id'])

ROOT = r'F:\Leontiev_Project'

'SpaceClaim.Api.V242.Geometry.Line'}, {'bounds': [0.0, 0.0030067789836031034], 'start': [0.7, 0.01749977111015984, 0.0], 'end': [0.7, 0.014492992126556737, 0.0], 'type': 'SpaceClaim.Api.V242.Geometry.Line'}, {'bounds': [0.0, 0.694115991927624], 'start': [0.005884008072375991, 0.017499771110159625, 0.0], 'end': [0.7, 0.01749977111015984, 0.0], 'type': 'SpaceClaim.Api.V242.Geometry.Line'}]}}
    p = dict((k, float(v)/1000.0) for k,v in values.items())
    def v(name): return p[name + '_mm']
    for name, value in p.items():
        if math.isnan(value) or math.isinf(value):
            raise ValueError('Non-finite parameter: '+name)
        if name not in ('x_origin_mm','secondary_inlet_offset_mm') and value <= 0:
            raise ValueError('Parameter must be positive: '+name)
    if not 0 < v('inlet_curve_offset') < v('l_convergent'):
        raise ValueError('Inlet curve offset must be inside convergent length')
    if not v('r_throat') < min(v('r_inlet'),v('r_nozzle_exit')):
        raise ValueError('Throat radius must be smaller than inlet and nozzle exit')
    if v('r_exit_rounding') <= v('l_exit_rounding')/2:
        raise ValueError('Rounding radius must exceed half its chord length')
    x0=v('x_origin'); xt=x0+v('l_convergent'); xn=xt+v('l_nozzle'); xh=xn+v('l_heat_exchange')
    xi=xn+v('secondary_inlet_offset')
    if xi >= xh: raise ValueError('Secondary inlet is beyond heat exchange end')
    ri=v('r_inlet'); rt=v('r_throat'); rn=v('r_nozzle_exit'); rh=v('r_heat_exchange_end')
    rw0=rn+v('wall_thickness_inlet'); rw1=rh+v('wall_thickness_end')
    ro0=rw0+v('gap_secondary_inlet'); ro1=rw1+v('gap_secondary_end')
    xa=xh+v('l_exit_contraction'); xb=xa+v('l_exit_rounding'); xc=xb+v('l_exit_recovery'); xo=xc+v('l_exit_tail')
    rneck=v('r_exit_neck'); rout=v('r_outlet'); rad=v('r_exit_rounding'); half=v('l_exit_rounding')/2
    cy=rneck+math.sqrt(rad*rad-half*half)
    if cy-rad <= 0: raise ValueError('Rounded neck crosses the axis')
    def pt(x,y): return Point.Create(x,y,0)
    def line(a,b): return CurveSegment.Create(pt(*a),pt(*b))
    def spline(info, transform):
        knots=Array[Knot]([Knot(k['parameter'], k['multiplicity']) for k in info['knots']])
        cps=Array[ControlPoint]([ControlPoint(pt(*transform(cp['position'][0],cp['position'][1])),cp['weight']) for cp in info['control_points']])
        curve=NurbsCurve.CreateFromControlPoints(NurbsData(info['degree']+1,False,False,knots),cps)
        return CurveSegment.Create(curve,Interval.Create(*info['bounds']))
    svz=reference['air_svz']['edges']; refx=svz[4]['start'][0]; reft=svz[1]['start']; refin=svz[2]['start']; refri=refin[1]
    inlet=spline(svz[3], lambda x,y:(x0+(x-refx)/(refin[0]-refx)*v('inlet_curve_offset'), y/refri*ri))
    contraction=spline(svz[2], lambda x,y:(x0+v('inlet_curve_offset')+(x-refin[0])/(reft[0]-refin[0])*(v('l_convergent')-v('inlet_curve_offset')),rt+(y-reft[1])/(refri-reft[1])*(ri-rt)))
    frame=Frame.Create(pt((xa+xb)/2,cy),Direction.Create(0,-1,0),Direction.Create(1,0,0))
    arc=CurveSegment.Create(Circle.Create(frame,rad),Interval.Create(-math.asin(half/rad),math.asin(half/rad)))
    core=[line((xn,rn),(xh,rh)),line((xt,rt),(xn,rn)),contraction,inlet,line((x0,0),(xo,0)),line((xo,rout),(xo,0)),line((xc,rout),(xo,rout)),line((xb,rneck),(xc,rout)),arc,line((xh,rh),(xa,rneck))]
    wall=[line((xi,rw0),(xh,rw1)),line((xh,rw1),(xh,rh)),core[0],line((xn,rn),(xi,rw0))]
    secondary=[line((xi,rw0),(xi,ro0)),wall[0],line((xh,ro1),(xh,rw1)),line((xi,ro0),(xh,ro1))]
    loops=[('air_svz',core),('wall_abonite',wall),('air_dzv',secondary)]
    # Validate all sheets before replacing any existing bodies.
    shapes=[]
    for name,curves in loops:
        collection=List[ITrimmedCurve]()
        for c in curves: collection.Add(c)
        shape=Body.CreatePlanarBody(Plane.PlaneXY,collection)
        if name == 'air_svz':
            cuts=List[ITrimmedCurve]()
            for x,y in ((xt,rt),(xn,rn),(xh,rh)):
                cuts.Add(line((x,0),(x,y)))
            slope=(rn-rt)/(xn-xt)
            normal_factor=math.sqrt(1+slope*slope)
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                h=total*normal_factor
                if h>=rt: raise ValueError('Nozzle boundary layers exceed throat radius')
                cuts.Add(line((xt,rt-h),(xn,rn-h)))
            heat_normal_factor=math.sqrt(1+((rh-rn)/(xh-xn))**2)
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                if total*max(normal_factor,heat_normal_factor)>=min(rn,rh):
                    raise ValueError('Heat boundary layers exceed local channel radius')
                # Match the same layer endpoints at the nozzle/heat interface.
                cuts.Add(line((xn,rn-total*normal_factor),(xh,rh-total*heat_normal_factor)))
            xstart=x0+v('inlet_curve_offset')
            for x,y in ((xstart,ri),(xa,rneck),(xb,rneck),(xc,rout)):
                cuts.Add(line((x,0),(x,y)))
            total=0.0
            for layer in range(20):
                total+=first_layer_height_m*(1.2**layer)
                def transform_contraction(x,y):
                    xx=xstart+(x-refin[0])/(reft[0]-refin[0])*(v('l_convergent')-v('inlet_curve_offset'))
                    yy=rt+(y-reft[1])/(refri-reft[1])*(ri-rt)
                    factor=1+(normal_factor-1)*(xx-xstart)/(xt-xstart)
                    return (xx,yy-total*factor)
                cuts.Add(spline(svz[2],transform_contraction))
                cuts.Add(line((xh,rh-total*heat_normal_factor),(xa,rneck-total)))
                lower_frame=Frame.Create(pt((xa+xb)/2,cy-total),Direction.Create(0,-1,0),Direction.Create(1,0,0))
                cuts.Add(CurveSegment.Create(Circle.Create(lower_frame,rad),Interval.Create(-math.asin(half/rad),math.asin(half/rad))))
                cuts.Add(line((xb,rneck-total),(xc,rout-total)))
                cuts.Add(line((xc,rout-total),(xo,rout-total)))
            shape.ImprintCurves(cuts,None)
        shapes.append((name,shape))
    root=GetRootPart()
    if clear_existing:
        for g in list(root.Groups):
            # Preserve native script parameters and the published rebuilding script.
            if not g.HasDimension and g.Name != 'TubeGeometry' and not g.Name.startswith('GEO_'): g.Delete()
        for body in list(PartExtensions.GetAllBodies(root)): body.Delete()
    created={}
    for name,shape in shapes:
        created[name]=DesignBody.Create(root,name,shape)
    def group(name,items):
        collection=List[IDocObject]()
        for item in items: collection.Add(item)
        return Group.Create(root,name,collection)
    for name,body in created.items(): group(name,list(body.Faces))
    def match_edge(body,curve):
        a=curve.StartPoint; b=curve.EndPoint
        def distance(c,d): return math.sqrt((c.X-d.X)**2+(c.Y-d.Y)**2+(c.Z-d.Z)**2)
        hits=[]
        for e in body.Edges:
            q=e.Shape
            if min(distance(q.StartPoint,a)+distance(q.EndPoint,b),distance(q.StartPoint,b)+distance(q.EndPoint,a)) < 1e-7:
                hits.append(e)
        if len(hits)!=1: raise ValueError('Ambiguous edge match for '+body.Name)
        return hits[0]
    s=created['air_svz']; d=created['air_dzv']; w=created['wall_abonite']
    sections=[('convergent',x0+v('inlet_curve_offset'),xt),('nozzle',xt,xn),('heat',xn,xh),('exit_contraction',xh,xa),('exit_rounding',xa,xb),('exit_recovery',xb,xc),('exit_tail',xc,xo)]
    all_structured=[]
    for section,lo,hi in sections:
        faces=[]
        for face in s.Faces:
            xs=[q.X for e in face.Edges for q in (e.Shape.StartPoint,e.Shape.EndPoint)]
            if abs(min(xs)-lo)<1e-8 and abs(max(xs)-hi)<1e-8:faces.append(face)
        if len(faces)!=21 or any(f.Edges.Count!=4 for f in faces):raise ValueError('Expected 21 four-sided strips in '+section+'; found '+str(len(faces)))
        group('MESH_'+section,faces)
        all_structured+=faces
        axial=[];thin=[];bulk=[]
        for e in s.Edges:
            a=e.Shape.StartPoint;b=e.Shape.EndPoint
            if min(a.X,b.X)>=lo-1e-8 and max(a.X,b.X)<=hi+1e-8:
                if abs(a.X-b.X)>1e-8:axial.append(e)
                elif abs(a.Y-b.Y)<0.0002:thin.append(e)
                else:bulk.append(e)
        if (len(axial),len(thin),len(bulk))!=(22,40,2):raise ValueError('Bad partition in '+section+': '+str((len(axial),len(thin),len(bulk))))
        group('MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges',axial)
        group('MESH_'+section+'_layer_edges',thin)
        group('MESH_'+section+'_core_radial_edges',bulk)
    group('MESH_core_structured',all_structured)
    group('MESH_inflation_svz',[f for f in s.Faces if f not in all_structured])
    group('inlet_svz',[match_edge(s,core[3])]); group('axis',[e for e in s.Edges if abs(e.Shape.StartPoint.Y)<1e-9 and abs(e.Shape.EndPoint.Y)<1e-9]); group('outlet_svz',[e for e in s.Edges if abs(e.Shape.StartPoint.X-xo)<1e-9 and abs(e.Shape.EndPoint.X-xo)<1e-9])
    group('wall_outer-air_svz',[match_edge(s,core[i]) for i in (1,2,6,7,8,9)])
    group('wall-air_svz-wall_abonite',[match_edge(s,core[0]),match_edge(w,wall[2])])
    group('interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite',[match_edge(d,secondary[1]),match_edge(w,wall[0])])
    group('wall-wall_abonite',[match_edge(w,wall[i]) for i in (1,3)])
    group('inlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[0])]); group('outlet_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[2])]); group('wall_outer-air_dzv',[match_edge(d,secondary[3])])
    return {'bodies':[(b.Name,b.Faces.Count,b.Edges.Count) for b in created.values()], 'x_nozzle_exit_m':xn,'x_heat_exchange_end_m':xh,'x_outlet_m':xo}


========================================================================
ФАЙЛ: dataset/a8_strategies.py
========================================================================
"""16.10.2026 — А8: comparison of CFD-point selection strategies on the A9 reference (author: S3 alpha 10 %, eps 0.5 K;
reference + many repeats + confirming CFD; metric = effect in K).

Reference ("truth"): GP regression of the effect (heating vs throttle, K) + GP classifier "channel working" (no shock in
the channel), both fitted on ALL converged A9 points (A9_11, A9_35, A9_36 excluded by the author 16.10).
Factors (6): t/d, L/d (designer X0, 3x3 grid) and dp_dzv (log), p_cons, t0_dzv, heater (dispatcher U).
Decision of the LPR: the point of the candidate pool with the largest predicted effect among points with
P(working) >= 1 - alpha.  Same model and same recommendation rule for every strategy; they differ only in which
points they ask for (and S3 in when it stops):
  S1  maximin Latin hypercube, the whole budget at once;
  S2  sequential GP, next point = largest predictive std of the effect;
  S3  decision rule: next point where the recommendation may change (classifier uncertain AND effect could exceed the
      current best, or the current best is itself uncertain); statuses 'выдать' / 'досчитать' / 'вернуть'; stop when
      P(recommended point is not working) < alpha and the expected gain of one more CFD < eps.
Metrics per run: regret (K) = true effect at the reference optimum - true effect at the recommendation; recommending a
non-working regime; number of CFD used.  Output: runs\\a8\\a8_runs.csv, a8_summary.md."""
import csv, json, math, sys, time, warnings
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import norm, qmc
from sklearn.gaussian_process import GaussianProcessRegressor, GaussianProcessClassifier
from sklearn.gaussian_process.kernels import Matern, ConstantKernel as Ck, WhiteKernel
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

A9 = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a9')
OUT = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a8')
EXCL = {'A9_11', 'A9_35', 'A9_36'}
ALPHA, EPS = 0.10, 0.5
N0, BUDGET, REPEATS, NOISE_K = 8, 24, 50, 0.05      # NOISE_K: repeat-from-scratch spread (A9_43/44: 0.00 / 0.01 K)
LEVELS = (8, 12, 16, 20, 24)   # budgets at which all strategies are compared (regret curve)
STABLE_K = 3                   # S3 'выдать': the recommendation unchanged over the last 3 CFD
TD, LD = (1.2, 1.4, 1.6), (30.0, 60.0, 100.0)
LO = np.array([1.2, 30.0, math.log(0.5), 0.3, -10.0, 0.0])
HI = np.array([1.6, 100.0, math.log(139.0), 1.6, 20.0, 20.0])
NAMES = ['t/d', 'L/d', 'ln dp_dzv', 'p_cons', 'T0_dzv', 'heater']


def load():
    design = {p['id']: p for p in csv.DictReader(open(A9 / 'a9_design.csv', encoding='utf-8'))}
    res = {r['tag']: r for r in csv.DictReader(open(A9 / 'a9_results.csv', encoding='utf-8'))}
    X, y, w, ids = [], [], [], []
    global LOGM
    LOGM = []
    for s in csv.DictReader(open(A9 / 'a9_points_status.csv', encoding='utf-8')):
        if s['id'] in EXCL or s['num_status'] != 'сошлась':
            continue
        p, r = design[s['id']], res[s['result']]
        LOGM.append(math.log(float(s['m'])))
        X.append([float(p['t_d']), float(p['L_d']), math.log(float(p['dp_dzv_kPa'])), float(p['p_cons']),
                  float(p['t0_dzv']), float(p['heater'])])
        y.append(float(r['dT_svz_vs_throttle']))
        w.append(0 if r.get('x_shock_m') else 1)
        ids.append(s['id'])
    return np.array(X), np.array(y), np.array(w), ids


def z(X):
    return (np.asarray(X) - LO) / (HI - LO)


def gpr(X, y):
    k = Ck(1.0) * Matern(length_scale=np.ones(6), length_scale_bounds=(0.05, 20), nu=2.5) + WhiteKernel(1e-3, (1e-6, 1e-1))
    return GaussianProcessRegressor(k, normalize_y=True, n_restarts_optimizer=2, random_state=0).fit(z(X), y)


def gpc(X, w):
    """'Working' classifier: GP regression of the label +1 / -1, P(working) = Phi(mean / std).  (sklearn's Laplace GPC
    was tried first: its probabilities never exceed ~0.92 even deep inside the working region, so the alpha = 10 %
    rule could not be met at all.)  Confident far inside a class, uncertain at the boundary and far from data."""
    k = Ck(1.0) * Matern(length_scale=np.ones(6), length_scale_bounds=(0.05, 20), nu=2.5) + WhiteKernel(1e-2, (1e-4, 0.3))
    return GaussianProcessRegressor(k, normalize_y=False, n_restarts_optimizer=1, random_state=0).fit(z(X), 2.0 * w - 1.0)


def p_work(c, X):
    mu, sd = c.predict(z(X), return_std=True)
    return norm.cdf(mu / np.maximum(sd, 1e-6))


M_RANGE = (0.2, 1.0)   # 16.10 v2: validated m range (A5, author 11.10); v1 searched up to m ~3-4 (t/d 1.6, dp 100 kPa)
M_MODEL = None


def pool(rng, n_per_geo=250):
    """Candidates: 9 geometries x LHS of the regime; kept only where the predicted m = G_DZV/G_SVZ is inside the validated
    range (GP of ln m fitted on all A9 points) — the decision space of the LPR is the validated region."""
    global M_MODEL
    if M_MODEL is None:
        Xa, _, _, _ = load()
        M_MODEL = gpr(Xa, np.array(LOGM))
    s = qmc.LatinHypercube(d=4, seed=rng.integers(1 << 31)).random(n_per_geo * 9 * 4)
    U = LO[2:] + s * (HI[2:] - LO[2:])
    G = np.array([(t, l) for t in TD for l in LD]).repeat(n_per_geo * 4, axis=0)
    P = np.hstack([G, U])
    m = np.exp(M_MODEL.predict(z(P)))
    P = P[(m >= M_RANGE[0]) & (m <= M_RANGE[1])]
    keep = []
    for t in TD:
        for l in LD:   # equal number of candidates per geometry
            idx = np.where((P[:, 0] == t) & (P[:, 1] == l))[0]
            keep.extend(rng.permutation(idx)[:n_per_geo])
    return P[np.array(keep)]


def recommend(m, c, P):
    mu = m.predict(z(P))
    pw = p_work(c, P)
    ok = pw >= 1 - ALPHA
    i = int(np.argmax(np.where(ok, mu, -1e9))) if ok.any() else int(np.argmax(pw))
    return i, ok.any()


def maximin_lhs(P, n, rng, tries=30):
    best, bd = None, -1
    for _ in range(tries):
        idx = rng.choice(len(P), n, replace=False)
        Z = z(P[idx]); d = np.sqrt(((Z[:, None] - Z[None]) ** 2).sum(-1)); d[np.diag_indices(n)] = 9
        if d.min() > bd:
            best, bd = idx, d.min()
    return list(best)


def run_one(strategy, ref_m, ref_c, P, true_mu, true_w, rng, start_seed=0):
    """One strategy, one start; the 'CFD' answer is the reference (+ repeat noise)."""
    def ask(i):
        return true_mu[i] + rng.normal(0, NOISE_K), int(true_w[i])
    best_true = float(true_mu[np.argmax(np.where(true_w, true_mu, -1e9))])
    curve = {}   # n CFD -> (regret K, recommended point not working)
    if strategy == 'S1':   # a separate maximin LHS for every budget level
        for n in LEVELS:
            obs = {i: ask(i) for i in maximin_lhs(P, n, rng)}
            Xo = P[list(obs)]; yo = np.array([v[0] for v in obs.values()]); wo = np.array([v[1] for v in obs.values()])
            rec, feasible = recommend(gpr(Xo, yo), gpc(Xo, wo), P)
            curve[n] = (best_true - float(true_mu[rec]), int(not true_w[rec]))
    start = maximin_lhs(P, N0, np.random.default_rng(start_seed))   # the same start set for S2 and S3 in one repeat
    obs = {i: ask(i) for i in start}
    status, stop_reason, hist, stop = 'досчитать', 'бюджет', [], None
    while strategy != 'S1':
        Xo = P[list(obs)]; yo = np.array([v[0] for v in obs.values()]); wo = np.array([v[1] for v in obs.values()])
        m, c = gpr(Xo, yo), gpc(Xo, wo)
        rec, feasible = recommend(m, c, P)
        if len(obs) in LEVELS:
            curve[len(obs)] = (best_true - float(true_mu[rec]), int(not true_w[rec]))
        hist.append((tuple(P[rec][:2]), float(m.predict(z(P[rec:rec + 1]))[0])))
        if len(obs) >= BUDGET:
            break
        mu, sd = m.predict(z(P), return_std=True)
        pw = p_work(c, P)
        if strategy == 'S2':
            cand = sd.copy(); cand[list(obs)] = -1
            nxt = int(np.argmax(cand))
        else:   # S3
            best = mu[rec]
            ei = (mu - best) * norm.cdf((mu - best) / np.maximum(sd, 1e-9)) + sd * norm.pdf((mu - best) / np.maximum(sd, 1e-9))
            gain = ei * pw                                  # expected improvement of the decision, feasible part
            bound = pw * (1 - pw) * 4 * np.maximum(mu - best + 2 * sd, 0)   # boundary points that could flip the choice
            risk_rec = 1 - pw[rec]
            confirmed = rec in obs and obs[rec][1] == 1   # 'выдать' only after the recommended point itself is computed
            stable = len(hist) >= STABLE_K and len({h[0] for h in hist[-STABLE_K:]}) == 1 and \
                max(h[1] for h in hist[-STABLE_K:]) - min(h[1] for h in hist[-STABLE_K:]) < EPS
            if stop is None and confirmed and stable and risk_rec < ALPHA and gain.max() < EPS and feasible:
                # the decision rule stops here; the run goes on only to draw the same regret curve as S2
                status, stop_reason = 'выдать', 'подтверждена CFD, устойчива, P(ошибки) < α, выигрыш < ε'
                stop = (len(obs), best_true - float(true_mu[rec]), int(not true_w[rec]))
            score = np.maximum(gain, bound)
            if rec not in obs:        # the recommended point itself not computed -> compute it (confirming CFD)
                score[rec] = score.max() + 1
            score[list(obs)] = -1
            nxt = int(np.argmax(score))
        obs[nxt] = ask(nxt)
    if strategy == 'S1':
        n_used, reg_used, bad_used = BUDGET, *curve[BUDGET]
        rec_txt = ''
    else:
        if not feasible and stop is None:
            status = 'вернуть'
        n_used, reg_used, bad_used = stop if stop else (len(obs), best_true - float(true_mu[rec]), int(not true_w[rec]))
        rec_txt = f'{P[rec][0]:.1f}/{P[rec][1]:.0f}'
    row = dict(strategy=strategy, n_cfd=n_used, regret_K=round(reg_used, 3), rec_not_working=bad_used, status=status,
               stop=stop_reason, rec_geometry=rec_txt)
    for n in LEVELS:
        row[f'regret_{n}'] = round(curve[n][0], 3)
        row[f'bad_{n}'] = curve[n][1]
    return row


def loo(X, y, w):
    """Accuracy of the reference itself: leave-one-out."""
    e, hit = [], []
    for i in range(len(X)):
        k = np.arange(len(X)) != i
        e.append(float(gpr(X[k], y[k]).predict(z(X[i:i + 1]))[0] - y[i]))
        hit.append(int((p_work(gpc(X[k], w[k]), X[i:i + 1])[0] >= 0.5) == w[i]))
    return np.array(e), np.array(hit)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    X, y, w, ids = load()
    t0 = time.time()
    e, hit = loo(X, y, w)
    ref_m, ref_c = gpr(X, y), gpc(X, w)
    info = dict(points=len(X), working=int(w.sum()), effect_range=[float(y.min()), float(y.max())],
                loo_rmse_K=round(float(np.sqrt((e ** 2).mean())), 3), loo_mae_K=round(float(np.abs(e).mean()), 3),
                loo_class_acc=round(float(hit.mean()), 3), kernel=str(ref_m.kernel_))
    print(json.dumps(info, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), flush=True)
    rows = []
    for rep in range(REPEATS):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(1000 + rep)
        P = pool(rng)
        true_mu, true_w = ref_m.predict(z(P)), p_work(ref_c, P) >= 0.5
        for s in ('S1', 'S2', 'S3'):
            r = run_one(s, ref_m, ref_c, P, true_mu, true_w, np.random.default_rng(rep * 10 + int(s[1])), 5000 + rep)
            r['repeat'] = rep
            rows.append(r)
        print(f'{rep + 1}/{REPEATS} {time.time() - t0:.0f} s', flush=True)
        with open(OUT / 'a8_runs.csv', 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            wr = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(rows[0])); wr.writeheader(); wr.writerows(rows)
    lines = ['# А8 — итог сравнения стратегий на эталоне А9', '', f'Эталон: {json.dumps(info, ensure_ascii=False)}', '',
             f'N0 = {N0}, бюджет ≤ {BUDGET}, повторов {REPEATS}, α = {ALPHA}, ε = {EPS} K, шум повтора {NOISE_K} K', '',
             '## Недобор эффекта рекомендации (K), среднее / 90 % по повторам, при числе CFD',
             '| Стратегия | ' + ' | '.join(str(n) for n in LEVELS) + ' |', '|---|' + '---|' * len(LEVELS)]
    for s in ('S1', 'S2', 'S3'):
        rr = [r for r in rows if r['strategy'] == s]
        cells = []
        for n in LEVELS:
            reg = np.array([r[f'regret_{n}'] for r in rr]); bad = np.mean([r[f'bad_{n}'] for r in rr])
            cells.append(f'{reg.mean():.2f} / {np.quantile(reg, 0.9):.2f}' + (f' (недоп. {100 * bad:.0f} %)' if bad else ''))
        lines.append(f'| {s} | ' + ' | '.join(cells) + ' |')
    rr = [r for r in rows if r['strategy'] == 'S3']
    st = [r for r in rr if r['status'] == 'выдать']
    lines += ['', '## S3 — остановка по правилу ЛПР (α, ε, подтверждение CFD, устойчивость)',
              f"- «выдать»: {100 * len(st) / len(rr):.0f} % повторов; «вернуть»: {100 * np.mean([r['status'] == 'вернуть' for r in rr]):.0f} %; "
              f"не остановился до бюджета {BUDGET}: {100 * np.mean([r['status'] == 'досчитать' for r in rr]):.0f} %"]
    if st:
        reg = np.array([r['regret_K'] for r in st])
        lines.append(f"- при «выдать»: CFD {np.mean([r['n_cfd'] for r in st]):.1f} (мин {min(r['n_cfd'] for r in st)}, "
                     f"макс {max(r['n_cfd'] for r in st)}); недобор {reg.mean():.2f} K (90 % — {np.quantile(reg, 0.9):.2f}); "
                     f"доля с недобором < ε: {100 * np.mean(reg < EPS):.0f} %; недопустимый режим: "
                     f"{100 * np.mean([r['rec_not_working'] for r in st]):.0f} %")
    (OUT / 'a8_summary.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print('\n'.join(lines))

"""30.10.2026 — задание автора, Fluent п. 2: A9_19 с удлинённым выходным участком — проверить, что обратный ток — артефакт
границы, а не режим. Уточнение по расчётам: обратный ток у A9_19, KM01, KM02r — на выходе СВЗ (pressure-outlet 15, 110 граней
= outlet_svz; у outlet_dzv, 88 граней, обратного тока нет). Поэтому удлиняется выходной участок СВЗ: хвост после диффузора
восстановления (P21, l_exit_tail_mm) 3 → 100 мм (≈ 10 диаметров выхода); остальное — как у A9_19 (сетка work_v2, режим, ПР).
Старт — перенос поля A9_19 (интерполяция, без подстановки ДЗВ), одна попытка, ≤ 3000 итераций.
Итог: runs\\a9_exit\\сравнение_выход.md — эффект, Q, расходы, обратный ток против A9_19; «артефакт границы», если на новом
выходе обратного тока нет (≤ 1 % площади) и эффект / Q не изменились (≤ 0,05 K / ≤ 1 %).
31.10.2026 — перенос поля разошёлся на 20-й итерации (в новом хвосте T упёрлась в 1 K); решение автора по ночи 31.10, п. 4:
одна попытка С НУЛЯ, без переноса поля (python a9_19_long_exit.py scratch → тег A9_19xs, scratch_one.run); не сошлось —
записать и идти дальше."""
import csv, json, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r'F:\Leontiev_Project\dataset')
import run_a9 as A
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import scratch_one as SO

SRC = A.BASE / 'A9_19'
OUT = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\a9_exit')
TAIL_MM = 100.0
LIMIT = 3000
SCRATCH = 'scratch' in sys.argv[1:]
TAG = 'A9_19xs' if SCRATCH else 'A9_19x'
HOW = 'с нуля, без переноса поля' if SCRATCH else 'перенос поля A9_19'
A.BASE, A.CSV, A.AUX = OUT, OUT / 'exit_results.csv', OUT / 'exit_aux.csv'
A.A3.MESHES['work_v2'] = dict(A.A3.MESHES['work_v2'], l_exit_tail_mm=TAIL_MM)   # только в этом процессе


def row(tag, f):
    rs = [r for r in csv.DictReader(open(f, encoding='utf-8')) if r['tag'] == tag] if Path(f).exists() else []
    return rs[-1] if rs else None


def main():
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    A.qlog(f'=== A9_19 с удлинённым выходом СВЗ (хвост {TAIL_MM:.0f} мм, {HOW}) — начат')
    pt = dict(next(p for p in csv.DictReader(open(SRC.parent / 'a9_design.csv', encoding='utf-8')) if p['id'] == 'A9_19'), id=TAG)
    reg = A.regime(pt)
    t0s, t0d = float(pt['t0_svz']), float(pt['t0_dzv'])
    A.G.RUNS = OUT
    d = A.done_dir(pt['id'])
    if not d and SCRATCH:
        d = SO.run(A, pt, TAG, 400.0, f'с нуля, хвост выхода {TAIL_MM:.0f} мм (решение автора 31.10, одна попытка)')
    elif not d:
        p, _ = A.cell_params(1.4, 400.0, 'A9_19x_tpl', pt, 'ch4_ideal', 10, 10)
        A.log(f'=== A9_19x: шаблон с хвостом выхода {TAIL_MM:.0f} мм; перенос поля A9_19')
        A.G.run(p, lambda s: A.log('  ' + s), lambda: False)
        tpl = OUT / 'A9_19x_tpl' / 'result.cas.h5'
        if not tpl.exists():
            tpl = OUT / 'A9_19x_tpl' / 'initial.cas.h5'
        ip = OUT / 'ip' / 'A9_19.ip'
        ip.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        if not tpl.exists() or not (ip.exists() or A.write_ip(SRC / 'result.cas.h5', ip)):
            A.log('  A9_19x: нет шаблона или файла переноса'); A.qlog('=== A9_19x: сбой (нет шаблона / переноса)'); return 1
        A.set_step(A.CONS)
        A.U.LIMIT = LIMIT
        out = OUT / pt['id']
        mins = A.U.continue_case(tpl, out, list(L.CH4_PR_LINES) + [f'/file/interpolate/read-data "{L.fl(ip)}"'], reg, A.log, pt['id'],
                                 t0_C=t0s, t0_dzv_C=t0d)
        A.U.record(A.CSV, pt['id'], 'work_v2', 'ch4_pr', reg, out, mins, A.log, start=f'перенос поля A9_19, хвост выхода {TAIL_MM:.0f} мм',
                   t0_C=t0s, t0_dzv_C=t0d, l_heat_mm=400.0)
        d = out if A.ok(out) else None
    r0, r1 = row('A9_19', SRC.parent / 'a9_results.csv'), row(TAG, A.CSV)
    if not r1 or not r1.get('dT_svz_vs_throttle'):
        A.qlog(f'=== {TAG}: нет результата (одна попытка, {HOW})')
        with open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\Журнал_работ.md', 'a', encoding='utf-8') as fj:
            fj.write(f'- {time.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")} — A9_19 с удлинённым выходом СВЗ ({HOW}, одна попытка): нет результата — '
                     f'вопрос «граница или режим» не решён расчётом; по решению автора 31.10 — записано, очередь идёт дальше\n')
        return 1
    f = lambda r, k: float(r[k]) if r.get(k) not in (None, '') else float('nan')
    de, dq = f(r1, 'dT_svz_vs_throttle') - f(r0, 'dT_svz_vs_throttle'), 100 * (f(r1, 'Q') / f(r0, 'Q') - 1)
    rev1 = f(r1, 'reversed_max_pct')
    conv = bool(d) and A.converged(d)
    artifact = rev1 <= 1.0 and abs(de) <= 0.05 and abs(dq) <= 1.0
    verdict = ('артефакт границы: на удлинённом выходе обратного тока нет, эффект и Q не изменились' if artifact else
               'не артефакт (или не только): ' + '; '.join(s for s, c in ((f'обратный ток {rev1:.1f} % площади на новом выходе', rev1 > 1.0),
                                                                          (f'эффект изменился на {de:+.3f} K', abs(de) > 0.05),
                                                                          (f'Q изменилось на {dq:+.2f} %', abs(dq) > 1.0)) if c))
    keys = (('эффект против дросселя, K', 'dT_svz_vs_throttle'), ('Q, Вт', 'Q'), ('G СВЗ, кг/с', 'G_svz'), ('G ДЗВ, кг/с', 'G_dzv'),
            ('обратный ток на выходе СВЗ, % площади', 'reversed_max_pct'), ('M на выходе', 'M_outlet'), ('статус', 'status'), ('причина', 'reason'))
    Lm = [f'# A9_19: выходной участок СВЗ 3 → {TAIL_MM:.0f} мм, {HOW} ({time.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")})', '',
          'Зачем: проверить, что обратный ток на выходе (9–13 % площади у A9_19 и накатки) — артефакт границы, а не режим. '
          'Обратный ток — на выходе СВЗ (outlet_svz), у выхода ДЗВ его нет.', '',
          f'| величина | A9_19 (хвост 3 мм) | {TAG} (хвост 100 мм) |', '|---|---|---|']
    Lm += [f'| {n} | {r0.get(k, "")} | {r1.get(k, "")} |' for n, k in keys]
    Lm += ['', f'Сошёлся по критериям: {"да" if conv else "нет (предел итераций; см. дисбаланс по D-12)"}.', '', f'**Вывод:** {verdict}.']
    (OUT / 'сравнение_выход.md').write_text('\n'.join(Lm) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    (OUT / 'сравнение_выход.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(d_effect_K=de, d_Q_pct=dq, reversed_pct=rev1, converged=conv, artifact=artifact,
                                                           verdict=verdict), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding='utf-8')
    with open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\Журнал_работ.md', 'a', encoding='utf-8') as fj:
        fj.write(f'- {time.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")} — A9_19 с удлинённым выходом СВЗ (хвост {TAIL_MM:.0f} мм, {HOW}; '
                 f'{"сошёлся" if conv else "не сошёлся по критериям"}): эффект {de:+.3f} K, Q {dq:+.2f} %, '
                 f'обратный ток {rev1:.1f} % → {verdict} (runs\\a9_exit\\сравнение_выход.md)\n')
    A.qlog(f'=== {TAG} закончен: {verdict}')
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

"""Offline report correction; no Fluent/Workbench calls, no changes to CFD inputs.
A timestamped hash plan is required before each read-only analysis.
"""
import hashlib,json,math,re,statistics,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
D=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
R=D.parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(D))
import leontiev_pipeline as L
import grs_temps,passport,gui_runner as G

def now(fmt='o'):
    return subprocess.check_output(['powershell','-NoProfile','-Command','Get-Date -Format '+fmt],text=True).strip()
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(p).open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest().upper()
def save(p,v):
    Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
def sides(template):
    rows={}
    for filename in ('s4.trn','s5.trn'):
        for line in (Path(template)/filename).read_text(errors='replace').splitlines():
            m=re.match(r'^\s*\d+\s+(\S+)\s+wall\s+(\S+)\s+face\s*$',line)
            if m:rows[m[1]]=m[2]
            m=re.match(r'^>?\s*/mesh/modify-zones/zone-name\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s*$',line)
            if m and m[1] in rows:rows[m[2]]=rows[m[1]]
    out={}
    for ch,base in [('svz','wall-air_svz-wall_abonite'),('dzv','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite')]:
        pair={n:rows.get(n) for n in (base,base+'-shadow')}
        sol=[n for n,v in pair.items() if v=='latun']
        gas=[n for n,v in pair.items() if v in ('air','methane','ch4','ch4_pr')]
        if len(sol)!=1 or len(gas)!=1:raise RuntimeError('Unproven gas/solid pair '+str(pair))
        out[ch]=dict(solid=sol[0],gas=gas[0],materials=pair)
    return out

def samples(folder,side):
    out=[]
    for b in sorted(Path(folder).glob('coupled_*.trn')):
        ss,res=L.parse_trn(b)
        if not ss:continue
        if not res:raise RuntimeError('No iteration evidence '+str(b))
        for s in ss:
            f=s['flux'];q=f[side['dzv']['solid']]
            if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in (q,s['net'],s['inlet_mass_flow_rate_svz'],s['inlet_mass_flow_rate_dzv'])):raise RuntimeError('Nonfinite sample')
            out.append(dict(iteration=res[-1]['it'],Q=q,raw_Q=f['interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite'],G_svz=s['inlet_mass_flow_rate_svz'],G_dzv=s['inlet_mass_flow_rate_dzv'],net=s['net'],
                svz_pair_sum=f[side['svz']['solid']]+f[side['svz']['gas']],dzv_pair_sum=f[side['dzv']['solid']]+f[side['dzv']['gas']],
                solid_through_difference=f[side['svz']['solid']]+q,
                svz_channel_balance=f['inlet_svz']+f['outlet_svz']+f[side['svz']['gas']],
                dzv_channel_balance=f['inlet_dzv']+f['outlet_dzv']+f[side['dzv']['gas']],
                yp_svz=s.get('yp_svz'),yp_dzv_raw=s.get('yp_dzv')))
    if not out or len({r['iteration'] for r in out})!=len(out):raise RuntimeError('No/duplicate sample iterations')
    return out

def evaluate(rows,regime):
    last=rows[-1]['iteration'];w=[dict(r) for r in rows if r['iteration']>=last-1000]
    for r in w:
        r['effect']=grs_temps.outlet_temps(r['Q'],r['G_svz'],r['G_dzv'],273.15+regime['T0_svz'],regime['p_main'],regime['p_cons'],regime['p_out_dzv'],regime['p0_dzv'],T0_dzv_K=273.15+regime['T0_dzv'])['dT_svz_vs_throttle']
    mean=lambda k:statistics.mean(r[k] for r in w)
    amp=lambda k:(max(r[k] for r in w)-min(r[k] for r in w))/2
    a=[r for r in w if r['iteration']<=last-500];b=[r for r in w if r['iteration']>last-500]
    drift=lambda k:abs(statistics.mean(r[k] for r in a)-statistics.mean(r[k] for r in b)) if a and b else math.inf
    q=mean('Q')
    if abs(q)<1e-9:raise RuntimeError('Mean Q near zero')
    o=dict(n=len(w),it=[w[0]['iteration'],last],full_window=len(w)>=3 and last-w[0]['iteration']>=1000,Q=q,effect=mean('effect'),G_svz=mean('G_svz'),G_dzv=mean('G_dzv'),imb_pct=100*mean('net')/abs(q),imb_max_pct=max(100*abs(r['net']/r['Q']) for r in w),eff_amp=amp('effect'),Q_amp_pct=100*amp('Q')/abs(q),Gs_amp_pct=100*amp('G_svz')/abs(mean('G_svz')),Gd_amp_pct=100*amp('G_dzv')/abs(mean('G_dzv')),drift_eff=drift('effect'),drift_Q_pct=100*drift('Q')/abs(q),drift_Gs_pct=100*drift('G_svz')/abs(mean('G_svz')),drift_Gd_pct=100*drift('G_dzv')/abs(mean('G_dzv')),
        max_pair_mismatch_W=max(abs(r[k]) for r in w for k in ('svz_pair_sum','dzv_pair_sum')),max_solid_difference_W=max(abs(r['solid_through_difference']) for r in w),channel_mean_balance_W={ch:mean(ch+'_channel_balance') for ch in ('svz','dzv')},raw_Q_mean=mean('raw_Q'),samples=w)
    o['checks']=dict(imb=abs(o['imb_pct'])<1,eff=o['eff_amp']<=.05,Q=o['Q_amp_pct']<=1,G=max(o['Gs_amp_pct'],o['Gd_amp_pct'])<=.5,drift=o['drift_eff']<.025 and o['drift_Q_pct']<.5 and max(o['drift_Gs_pct'],o['drift_Gd_pct'])<.25)
    o['accepted']=o['full_window'] and all(o['checks'].values())
    return o

def audit(item):
    folder=Path(item['folder']);side=sides(item['template']);rr=samples(folder,side)
    o=evaluate(rr,passport.regime_from_jou((folder/'cont.jou').read_text(encoding='utf-8')));o['sides']=side
    o['files_complete']=all((folder/f).is_file() and (folder/f).stat().st_size>0 for f in ('result.cas.h5','result.dat.h5','axis.csv'))
    st=G.status(folder) or {};o['no_solver_error']=not st.get('fpe') and not st.get('error')
    o['accepted'] &= o['files_complete'] and o['no_solver_error']
    valid=side['dzv']['gas']=='interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite-shadow'
    o['yplus']=dict(svz=rr[-1]['yp_svz'],dzv=rr[-1]['yp_dzv_raw'] if valid else None,dzv_valid=valid,raw_dzv=rr[-1]['yp_dzv_raw'])
    o['physical']=G.classify(folder,{'l_heat_mm':400.},G.converged(folder))
    return o

def make_plan():
    out=R/'runs'/('grid_1103_report_audit_'+now('yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'));out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    items=[dict(tag='W1',folder=str(R/'runs/knurl_cont/W1'),template=str(R/'runs/patents/KM01_A9_19_tpl'))]
    for tag in ('G1','G2'):
        f=R/'runs/grid_1103_v8'/tag
        if all((f/n).is_file() for n in ('result.cas.h5','result.dat.h5','axis.csv')):items.append(dict(tag=tag,folder=str(f),template=str(f.parent/(tag+'_template'))))
    files=[]
    for item in items:
        f=Path(item['folder']);t=Path(item['template'])
        files+=list(f.glob('coupled_*.trn'))+list(f.glob('fluent-*.trn'))+[f/n for n in ('cont.jou','result.cas.h5','result.dat.h5','axis.csv')]+[t/n for n in ('s4.trn','s5.trn')]
    codes=[Path(__file__),D/'leontiev_pipeline.py',D/'grs_temps.py',D/'passport.py',D/'gui_runner.py']
    p=out/'plan.json';save(p,dict(made=now(),authorization='Author: continue handover and correct reporting; D47 unchanged; offline only.',items=items,expected=['W1','G1','G2'],output=str(out),source_sha256={str(f):sha(f) for f in files},code_sha256={str(f):sha(f) for f in codes},thresholds=dict(effect_K=.1,Q_pct=2,G_svz_pct=2,G_dzv_pct=2),rule='Trace material through actual rename commands. Q is measured solid-DZV flux, never abs(Q) chosen as correction. Recompute enthalpy per sample, unchanged D12a tolerances with magnitude denominators. No solver calls.'))
    p.with_suffix('.sha256').write_text(sha(p),encoding='ascii');print(p)

def run(p):
    p=Path(p);plan=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    if sha(p)!=p.with_suffix('.sha256').read_text().strip():raise RuntimeError('Changed plan')
    for f,h in {**plan['code_sha256'],**plan['source_sha256']}.items():
        if sha(f)!=h:raise RuntimeError('Changed input '+f)
    out=Path(plan['output'])
    if (out/'results.json').exists():raise RuntimeError('Already completed, use new timestamped plan')
    res={i['tag']:audit(i) for i in plan['items']};checks=[]
    for a,b in [('W1','G1'),('W1','G2'),('G1','G2')]:
        if a not in res or b not in res:continue
        x,y=res[a],res[b];d=dict(effect_K=abs(y['effect']-x['effect']))
        d.update({k+'_pct':100*abs(y[k]/x[k]-1) for k in ('Q','G_svz','G_dzv')})
        checks.append(dict(pair=[a,b],delta=d,passed=all(d[k]<=v for k,v in plan['thresholds'].items())))
    complete=set(res)==set(plan['expected'])
    summary=dict(finished=now(),complete=complete,pending=[k for k in plan['expected'] if k not in res],comparisons=checks,local_mesh_sensitivity_passed=complete and all(r['accepted'] for r in res.values()) and len(checks)==3 and all(c['passed'] for c in checks),limitation='Local nonuniform mesh sensitivity only. Not GCI, all shapes, or physics validation. New mesh DZV y+ needs correct gas-side measurement without iterations.')
    save(out/'results.json',res);save(out/'summary.json',summary)
    lines=['# Исправленная проверка отчёта по сторонам стыка','',summary['finished'],'','Только сохранённые данные: CFD, исходные отчёты и настройки не изменялись.','',
        '| Сетка | Q, Вт | Эффект, K | GСВЗ, кг/с | GДЗВ, кг/с | Дисбаланс, % Q | Окно | y+ ДЗВ |','|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|']
    for tag,r in res.items():lines.append(f"| {tag} | {r['Q']:.4f} | {r['effect']:.4f} | {r['G_svz']:.8f} | {r['G_dzv']:.8f} | {r['imb_pct']:+.4f} | {r['it']} | {r['yplus']['dzv'] if r['yplus']['dzv_valid'] else 'не измерен корректно'} |")
    lines+=['','Положительный Q — тепло из ДЗВ через стенку в СВЗ. Сторона доказана материалом и журналом переименования. Эффект заново вычислен по энтальпии, а не простым удалением минуса.',
        'Старый монитор y+ ДЗВ на новых сетках выбрал твёрдую сторону: служебное −1e20 было скрыто нулём внешней симметрии. Нулевой y+ не является результатом измерения; нужно чтение сохранённого поля без итераций.', '',json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)]
    (out/'report.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({k:{n:v[n] for n in ('Q','effect','imb_pct','accepted')} for k,v in res.items()},ensure_ascii=False));print(out/'report.md')
if __name__=='__main__':
    if sys.argv[1:]==['make-plan']:make_plan()
    elif len(sys.argv)==3 and sys.argv[1]=='run':run(sys.argv[2])
    else:raise SystemExit('make-plan | run PLAN')

"""30.10.2026 — интерфейс автора (решение автора 30.10), на Tkinter + matplotlib (уже установлены; новых пакетов нет).
Окно 1 «Что считается сейчас» — только просмотр: текущий расчёт (серия, точка), паспорт (геометрия, режим, сетка), ход счёта
(итерация, невязки, мониторы, дисбаланс энергии, y+, оценка времени), очередь (старые цепочки + общая очередь jobs.json).
31.10.2026 — шаги 2 и 3: окно 2 «Новая серия» (gui_series.py) и окно 3 «Результаты и датасет» (gui_results.py).
Интерфейс Fluent не запускает: только общая очередь (серии окна 2 считает job_point.py).
usage: python author_gui.py [--snapshot файл.png [номер вкладки 1–3]]; ярлык на рабочем столе — «Труба Леонтьева — интерфейс автора»."""
import json, math, re, sys, threading, time
from pathlib import Path

R = Path(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs')
LEGACY_LABEL = {'knurl_shallow.py': 'разведка мелкой накатки h 0,1 / 0,2 / 0,3 мм (KM01–KM03)', 'knurl_eqflow.py': 'накатка KS10 при равном расходе',
                'nozzle_series.py': 'сопло как фактор (D-26)', 'a3a_check.py': 'A3a — проверка на новых трубах',
                'confirm_runner.py': 'задача 2 за краем (sppr --confirm, CF…)', 'queue_1030c.py': 'ждёт: задача 2 за краем CF01–CF03 (после накатки)',
                'queue_1030b.py': 'цепочка: мелкая накатка', 'bundle3d_run.py': '3D-проверка'}
RES_COLS = ('iter', 'continuity', 'x-velocity', 'y-velocity', 'energy', 'k', 'omega')


def current_run():
    """Папка расчёта, в которую Fluent пишет сейчас (самый свежий журнал *.trn за последние 15 мин)."""
    best = None
    for pat in ('*/*/coupled_*.trn', '*/*/*.trn', '*/*/*/coupled_*.trn', '*/*/*/*.trn'):
        for f in R.glob(pat):
            m = f.stat().st_mtime
            if best is None or m > best[0]:
                best = (m, f)
    if best and time.time() - best[0] < 900:
        return best[1].parent, best[0]
    return None, best[0] if best else None


def residuals(d):
    bl = sorted(d.glob('coupled_*.trn')) or sorted(d.glob('fluent-*.trn'))
    for f in reversed(bl):
        rows = [ln.split() for ln in f.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').splitlines()
                if re.match(r'^\s*\d+\s+\d\.\d+e[-+]\d+', ln)]
        if rows:
            return {k: (int(v) if k == 'iter' else float(v)) for k, v in zip(RES_COLS, rows[-1])}
    return {}


def res_history(d, n_max=2000):
    """31.10: история невязок по каждой итерации (подъём run.trn + блоки coupled_*.trn; если их нет — полный журнал fluent-*.trn):
    видна с первых минут счёта, когда отчётов мониторов (раз в 500–1500 итераций) ещё один-два."""
    files = ([d / 'run.trn'] if (d / 'run.trn').exists() else []) + sorted(d.glob('coupled_*.trn'))
    if len(files) <= 1:
        files = sorted(d.glob('fluent-*.trn'), key=lambda f: f.stat().st_mtime) or files
    rows = {}
    for f in files:
        for ln in f.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').splitlines():
            if re.match(r'^\s*\d+\s+\d\.\d+e[-+]\d+', ln):
                v = ln.split()
                try:
                    r6 = [float(x) for x in v[1:7]]
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                if len(r6) == 6:   # только полные строки (непрерывность, x, y, энергия, k, ω); у шаблона/FMG столбцов меньше
                    rows[int(v[0])] = r6
    it = sorted(rows)
    step = max(1, len(it) // n_max)
    return [(i, *rows[i]) for i in it[::step]]


def speed_eta(d):
    """с/итерацию — по времени записи блоков coupled_*.trn (по 500 итераций); оценка до предела итераций."""
    bl = sorted(d.glob('coupled_*.trn'), key=lambda f: f.stat().st_mtime)
    cj = d / 'convergence.json'
    c = json.loads(cj.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if cj.exists() else {}
    sp = None
    if len(bl) >= 3:
        t = [f.stat().st_mtime for f in bl[:-1]]
        sp = (t[-1] - t[-2]) / 500.0
    return sp, c


def effect(pp, s):
    try:
        import grs_temps
        r = pp['regime']
        o = grs_temps.outlet_temps(s['Q'], s['m_svz'], s['m_dzv'], 273.15 + r['T0_svz'], r['p_main'], r['p_cons'], r['p_out_dzv'], r['p0_dzv'],
                                   T0_dzv_K=273.15 + r['T0_dzv'])
        return o.get('dT_svz_vs_throttle')
    except Exception:
        return None


def queue_view():
    rows, tot = [], 0.0
    for pid, cmd in QR.python_procs():
        for t in cmd.split():
            nm = Path(t.strip('"')).name
            if nm in LEGACY_LABEL:
                est = None
                if nm == 'knurl_shallow.py':
                    left = [v for v in ('KM01', 'KM02', 'KM03') if not any((R / 'patents').glob(f'{v}_eq*')) or v == 'KM01']
                    est = 2.5 * len([v for v in ('KM02', 'KM03') if not (R / 'patents' / f'{v}_A9_19').exists()]) + 1.0
                if nm == 'queue_1030c.py':
                    fc = json.loads((R / 'journal' / 'confirm_forecasts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
                    n = sum(1 for v in fc.values() if v.get('status') == 'в очереди')
                    est = 0.4 + 0.8 * n
                rows.append(('идёт' if nm not in ('queue_1030c.py', 'queue_1030b.py') else 'ждёт', 'старая цепочка', LEGACY_LABEL[nm], est))
                tot += est or 0
    for j in JQ.load():
        if j['status'] in ('ждёт', 'идёт'):
            rows.append((j['status'], j['id'], f"{j.get('series')} ({j.get('plan')})", float(j.get('est_h') or 0)))
            tot += float(j.get('est_h') or 0)
    return [r for r in rows if r[2] != LEGACY_LABEL['queue_1030b.py']], tot


def _d12a(d):
    """31.10 (D-12a, принято автором): сходимость при колебаниях — окно 1000 итераций, средние; для таблицы сходимости."""
    try:
        import d12a
        return d12a.evaluate(d)
    except Exception as e:
        return dict(ok=None, why=f'не оценено: {e!r}', n=0)


def snapshot():
    """Всё для окна 1 — одним словарём (считается в фоне)."""
    d, t_last = current_run()
    out = dict(time=time.strftime('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S'), run=None, t_last=t_last)
    if d:
        pp = PS.resolve(d)
        st = G.status(d) or {}
        res = residuals(d)
        sp, conv = speed_eta(d)
        s = (st.get('samples') or [None])[-1]
        out.update(run=d, pp=pp, st=st, res=res, speed=sp, conv=conv, last=s, eff=effect(pp, s) if s else None, rh=res_history(d),
                   hist=[(x['iteration'], effect(pp, x), x['Q'], x['m_dzv'], x['net']) for x in st.get('samples') or []],
                   every=st.get('every'), d12a=_d12a(d))
    out['queue'], out['queue_h'] = queue_view()
    return out


def fmt(v, f='{:.4g}', none='—'):
    return none if v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and math.isnan(v)) else f.format(v)


CONV = (('continuity', 'невязка неразрывности', '{:.1e}'), ('mass_svz_pct', 'баланс массы СВЗ, %', '{:.3f}'),
        ('energy_W', 'дисбаланс энергии, Вт (порог автостопа)', '{:.2f}'), ('drift_K_per_100', 'изменение эффекта за 100 итераций, K', '{:.4f}'),
        ('drift_Q_W_per_100', 'изменение Q за 100 итераций, Вт', '{:.3f}'), ('drift_flow_pct_per_100', 'изменение расхода СВЗ за 100 итераций, %', '{:.4f}'),
        ('drift_flow_dzv_pct_per_100', 'изменение расхода ДЗВ за 100 итераций, %', '{:.4f}'))


def conv_rows(c, last, it, mx):
    """31.10 (задание автора): таблица сходимости — критерий | сейчас | нужно | ✓/✗ (критерии автостопа из convergence.json,
    D-12 — дисбаланс энергии < 1 % Q, y+, лимит итераций)."""
    rows = []
    chk, lim = (c or {}).get('checks') or {}, (c or {}).get('limits') or {}
    for k, name, f in CONV:
        if k in chk:
            v = chk[k].get('value')
            rows.append((name, fmt(abs(v) if isinstance(v, (int, float)) else v, f), f"≤ {fmt(lim.get(k), '{:g}')}", bool(chk[k].get('passed'))))
    if last and last.get('Q'):
        pct = 100 * abs(last['net']) / abs(last['Q'])
        rows.append(('дисбаланс энергии, % Q (D-12: точка годна)', f'{pct:.2f}', '< 1', pct < 1.0))
        yp = max(last.get('yp_svz') or 0, last.get('yp_dzv') or 0)
        rows.append(('y+ max (СВЗ / ДЗВ)', f"{fmt(last.get('yp_svz'), '{:.2f}')} / {fmt(last.get('yp_dzv'), '{:.2f}')}", '≤ 1', yp <= 1.0))
    if it and mx:
        rows.append(('итерация', f'{it}', f'≤ {mx} (лимит)', it < mx))
    return rows

            self.refresh(); self.after(1000, self.poll); self.after(30000, self.loop)

    def loop(self):
        try:
            self.refresh()
        finally:
            self.after(30000, self.loop)

    def poll(self):   # Tk — только из главного потока: фон кладёт данные, окно их забирает
        try:
            if self.fresh:
                self.fresh = False; self.show()
        except Exception as e:   # 31.10: ошибка отрисовки не должна останавливать обновление окна
            import traceback; traceback.print_exc()
            self.head.config(text=f'Ошибка отрисовки: {e!r} (окно продолжает обновляться)')
        finally:
            self.after(1000, self.poll)

    def refresh(self, sync=False):
        def work():
            try:
                self.data = snapshot()
            except Exception as e:
                self.data = dict(error=repr(e), time=time.strftime('%H:%M:%S'))
            self.fresh, self.busy = True, False
        if sync:
            work(); self.fresh = False; self.show()
        elif not self.busy:
            self.busy = True
            threading.Thread(target=work, daemon=True).start()

    def show(self):
        s = self.data or {}
        self.upd.config(text=f"обновлено {s.get('time', '')}; обновление раз в 30 с")
        if s.get('error'):
            self.head.config(text='Ошибка чтения: ' + s['error']); return
        if not s.get('run'):
            self.head.config(text='Fluent сейчас ничего не пишет (последний журнал ' +
                             (time.strftime('%d.%m %H:%M', time.localtime(s['t_last'])) if s.get('t_last') else '—') + ')')
        else:
            pp, st, res, c, last = s['pp'], s['st'], s['res'], s['conv'], s['last']
            g, r, m = pp.get('geometry') or {}, pp.get('regime') or {}, pp.get('mesh') or {}
            self.head.config(text=f"Сейчас: {pp.get('series')} — точка {pp['tag']}  ({pp.get('how')}; план: {pp.get('plan')})")
            kn = g.get('knurl')
            self.boxes['geo'].config(text=(
                f"тип трубы        {pp.get('kind')}\n"
                f"t/d              {fmt(g.get('t_d'), '{:.3g}')}\n"
                f"L (теплообмен)   {fmt(g.get('L_mm'), '{:.0f}')} мм\n"
                f"сопло: горло ⌀   {fmt(2 * g['throat_mm'] if g.get('throat_mm') else None, '{:.2f}')} мм, срез ⌀ {fmt(2 * g['r_exit_mm'] if g.get('r_exit_mm') else None, '{:.2f}')} мм\n"
                f"  отношение площадей A/A* {fmt(g.get('area_ratio'), '{:.2f}')}\n"
                f"накатка          " + (f"h {kn['h_mm']} мм, шаг {kn['pitch_mm']} мм, ширина {kn['width_mm']} мм" if kn else 'гладкая') + '\n'
                f"зазор ДЗВ (2D)   {fmt(g.get('gap_mm'), '{:.2f}')} мм; стенка {fmt(g.get('wall_in_mm'), '{:.1f}')} → {fmt(g.get('wall_end_mm'), '{:.1f}')} мм"))
            self.boxes['reg'].config(text=(
                f"магистраль       {fmt(r.get('p_main'), '{:.3g}')} МПа\n"
                f"потребитель      {fmt(r.get('p_cons'), '{:.3g}')} МПа\n"
                f"перепад ДЗВ      {fmt(r.get('dp_dzv_kPa'), '{:.3g}')} кПа" + ('   ⚠ < 15 кПа — риск сбоя' if (r.get('dp_dzv_kPa') or 99) < 15 else '') + '\n'
                f"газ на входе     {fmt(r.get('T0_dzv'), '{:+.2f}')} °C;  подогрев СВЗ {fmt(r.get('heat_K'), '{:+.2f}')} K\n"
                f"модель газа      {r.get('gas', '—')}"))
            yps = last['yp_svz'] if last else None; ypd = last['yp_dzv'] if last else None
            self.boxes['mesh'].config(text=(
                f"версия           {m.get('preset', '—')} (шаг по оси {fmt(m.get('axial_mm'), '{:g}')} мм, слоёв ДЗВ {m.get('dzv_layers', '—')})\n"
                f"ячеек            {fmt(m.get('cells'), '{:,}').replace(',', ' ')}\n"
                f"y+ max           СВЗ {fmt(yps, '{:.2f}')},  ДЗВ {fmt(ypd, '{:.2f}')}"))
            sp, it, mx = s['speed'], res.get('iter') or st.get('iter'), c.get('max_iter')
            eta = (mx - it) * sp / 3600 if sp and mx and it else None
            chk = c.get('checks') or {}
            bad = [k for k, v in chk.items() if not v.get('passed')]
            self.boxes['prog'].config(text=(
                f"итерация         {it} из ≤ {mx or '—'}\n"
                f"невязки          непр. {fmt(res.get('continuity'), '{:.2e}')}  энерг. {fmt(res.get('energy'), '{:.2e}')}\n"
                f"                 k {fmt(res.get('k'), '{:.2e}')}  ω {fmt(res.get('omega'), '{:.2e}')}\n"
                f"эффект (против дросселя) {fmt(s.get('eff'), '{:+.2f}')} K\n"
                f"расход СВЗ / ДЗВ {fmt(last['m_svz'] if last else None, '{:.5f}')} / {fmt(last['m_dzv'] if last else None, '{:.5f}')} кг/с\n"
                f"тепло Q          {fmt(last['Q'] if last else None, '{:.1f}')} Вт;  дисбаланс энергии {fmt(last['net'] if last else None, '{:.2f}')} Вт\n"
                f"скорость         {fmt(sp, '{:.2f}')} с/итер.;  до предела ≈ {fmt(eta, '{:.1f}')} ч" +
                ('\nавтостоп: критерии выполнены — Fluent сохраняет кейс' if c.get('stop_requested') else '')))
            for i in self.ctree.get_children():   # 31.10: таблица сходимости
                self.ctree.delete(i)
            for name, now, need, ok in conv_rows(c, last, it, mx):
                self.ctree.insert('', 'end', values=(name, now, need, '✓' if ok else '✗'), tags=('ok' if ok else 'bad',))
            import d12a as D12   # 31.10: критерии D-12a (окно 1000 итераций) — той же таблицей
            e = s.get('d12a') or {}
            self.ctree.insert('', 'end', values=('— D-12a (окно 1000 итераций): ' + ('СОШЛАСЬ' if e.get('ok') else 'не сошлась' if e.get('ok') is False
                                                                                   else 'пока не оценить'), '', '', ''), tags=('hdr',))
            for name, now, need, ok in D12.rows_table(e):
                self.ctree.insert('', 'end', values=(name, now, need, '' if ok is None else '✓' if ok else '✗'),
                                  tags=('' if ok is None else 'ok' if ok else 'bad',))
            h, rh = s['hist'], s.get('rh') or []
            for a in self.ax:
                a.clear(); a.tick_params(labelsize=7)
            a = self.ax[0]   # невязки по каждой итерации — видны сразу
            if rh:
                for k, nm in ((1, 'непрерывность'), (4, 'энергия'), (5, 'k'), (6, 'ω')):
                    a.semilogy([x[0] for x in rh], [max(x[k], 1e-20) for x in rh], lw=0.8, label=nm)
                a.legend(fontsize=6, loc='upper right')
            a.set_title('Невязки (каждая итерация)', fontsize=9)
            # 31.10 (задание автора): «Изменение результата» — эффект, Q, расход ДЗВ в % от последнего значения; дисбаланс энергии
            # в % Q и красная линия 1 % (D-12); серая полоса допуска ±1 % (D-12); ось фиксирована ±2 %
            a = self.ax[1]
            a.axhspan(-1.0, 1.0, color='0.88', zorder=0, label='допуск ±1 % (D-12)')
            a.axhline(1.0, color='red', lw=1.2, label='дисбаланс 1 % Q (D-12)')
            a.axhline(0.0, color='0.5', lw=0.6)
            pts = [x for x in h if x[1] is not None and x[2]]
            if pts:
                it_ = [x[0] for x in pts]
                for k, nm, col in ((1, 'эффект', 'tab:blue'), (2, 'тепло Q', 'tab:orange'), (3, 'расход ДЗВ', 'tab:green')):
                    lastv = pts[-1][k]
                    a.plot(it_, [100 * (x[k] / lastv - 1) if lastv else 0 for x in pts], 'o-', ms=4, lw=1, color=col, label=f'{nm}, % от последнего')
                a.plot(it_, [100 * abs(x[4]) / abs(x[2]) for x in pts], 's--', ms=4, lw=1, color='tab:red', label='дисбаланс энергии, % Q')
            a.set_ylim(-2, 2)
            a.set_ylabel('%', fontsize=8)
            ev = (pts[-1][0] - pts[-2][0]) if len(pts) >= 2 else None   # фактический шаг отчётов
            a.set_title(f"Изменение результата (отчёты {len(pts)}" + (f', каждые {ev} итераций' if ev else '') + '; ось ±2 %, за пределами — обрезано)', fontsize=9)
            a.legend(fontsize=6, loc='lower left', ncol=3)
            self.fig.tight_layout(); self.canvas.draw_idle()
        for i in self.qtree.get_children():
            self.qtree.delete(i)
        for st_, jid, what, h in s.get('queue', []):
            self.qtree.insert('', 'end', values=(st_, jid, what, fmt(h, '{:.1f}')))
        self.qsum.config(text=f"всего в очереди ≈ {s.get('queue_h', 0):.1f} ч; общая очередь: runs\\queue\\jobs.json "
                              f"(исполнитель queue_runner.py — переход после старых цепочек)")

    if sys.stdout is None:   # 31.10: запуск ярлыком (pythonw) — консоли нет; вывод и ошибки фоновых потоков — в файл
        sys.stdout = sys.stderr = open(R / 'queue' / 'author_gui_log.txt', 'a', encoding='utf-8', buffering=1)

    app = App()

        if len(sys.argv) > k + 2:
            app.nb.select(int(sys.argv[k + 2]) - 1); app.update(); time.sleep(1.0); app.update()
        from PIL import ImageGrab
        x, y, w, h = app.winfo_rootx(), app.winfo_rooty(), app.winfo_width(), app.winfo_height()
        ImageGrab.grab(bbox=(x, y, x + w, y + h)).save(sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--snapshot') + 1])
        app.destroy()
    else:
        app.mainloop()

import datetime,json,math,re,subprocess,sys,time,hashlib

D=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(D));R=D.parent/'runs'

def resolve_live(rows):
    if isinstance(rows,dict):rows=[rows]
    rows=rows or []
    candidates=[]
    for row in rows:
        command=row.get('CommandLine') or ''
        m=re.search(r'(?:^|\s)-i\s+(?:"([^"]+\.jou)"|([^\s]+\.jou))',command,re.I)
        if not m:continue
        journal=Path(m[1] or m[2]).resolve()
        if journal.is_relative_to(R.resolve()) and journal.is_file():candidates.append((journal.parent,row))
    return candidates[0] if len(candidates)==1 else None

def live_run():
    command="@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name='cx2420.exe'\" | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine) | ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
    raw=subprocess.check_output(['powershell','-NoProfile','-Command',command],text=True,creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW).strip()
    return resolve_live(json.loads(raw) if raw else [])

def current_run():
    live=live_run()
    if live:return live[0],time.time()
    return ORIGINAL_CURRENT()

def enrich_passport(folder,pp):
    p=folder/'params.json'
    if not p.exists():return
    q=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'));kn=q.get('knurl_dzv')
    # Own parameter file must not be lost when passport.resolve follows a temporary template.
    pp.update(kind='накатка' if kn else pp.get('kind','гладкая'))
    pp['geometry']=dict(t_d=BASE.PS.td_from_gap(q['gap_mm']) if q.get('gap_mm') else None,L_mm=q.get('l_heat_mm'),gap_mm=q.get('gap_mm'),throat_mm=BASE.PS.THROAT,r_exit_mm=q.get('r_nozzle_exit_mm'),area_ratio=(q['r_nozzle_exit_mm']/BASE.PS.THROAT)**2 if q.get('r_nozzle_exit_mm') else None,wall_in_mm=q.get('wall_thickness_inlet_mm'),wall_end_mm=q.get('wall_thickness_end_mm'),knurl=kn)
    pp['mesh']=dict(preset='своя',axial_mm=q.get('axial_size_mm'),dzv_layers=q.get('dzv_layers'),dzv_h1_mm=q.get('dzv_h1_mm'),cells=None)
    state=folder.parent/'state.json'
    if state.exists():
        state=json.loads(state.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if state.get('tag')==folder.name:pp['mesh']['cells']=state.get('cells')
    pp['regime'].update({k:v for k,v in BASE.PS.regime_from_jou((folder/'cont.jou').read_text(encoding='utf-8')).items() if v is not None})
    pp['regime']['dp_dzv_kPa']=round(1000*(pp['regime']['p0_dzv']-pp['regime']['p_out_dzv']),3)
    pp['regime']['heat_K']=pp['regime']['T0_svz']-pp['regime']['T0_dzv']

def snapshot():
    s=ORIGINAL_SNAPSHOT();folder=s.get('run')
    if not folder:return s
    folder=Path(folder);pp=s['pp'];enrich_passport(folder,pp)
    template=folder.parent/(folder.name+'_template')
    if folder.parent.name=='grid_1103_v8' and (template/'s5.trn').exists():
        side=AUD.sides(template);rows=AUD.samples(folder,side)
        by_it={r['iteration']:r for r in rows}
        for row in s['st'].get('samples',[]):
            if row['iteration'] in by_it:row['Q']=by_it[row['iteration']]['Q']
            if side['dzv']['gas']!='interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite-shadow':row['yp_dzv']=float('nan')
        s['last']=(s['st'].get('samples') or [None])[-1]
        s['eff']=BASE.effect(pp,s['last']) if s['last'] else None
        s['hist']=[(r['iteration'],BASE.effect(pp,r),r['Q'],r['m_dzv'],r['net']) for r in s['st'].get('samples',[])]
        if len(rows)>=3:
            e=AUD.evaluate(rows,pp['regime']);e.update(ok=e['accepted'],why='; '.join(k for k,v in e['checks'].items() if not v));s['d12a']=e
        else:s['d12a']=dict(ok=None,n=len(rows),why='ещё нет полного окна1000итераций')
        s['corrected_wall_sides']=side
    plan=R/'plans/проверка_сетки_1103_v9_автостоп.json'
    state=R/'autostop_d12a_1103_v2/state.json'
    if plan.exists() and state.exists():
        p=json.loads(plan.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if Path(p['target']).resolve()==folder.resolve():
            state=json.loads(state.read_text(encoding='utf-8'));s['d48']=state;s['conv']['d48']=state
    return s

def conv_rows(c,last,it,mx):
    if not (c or {}).get('d48'):return ORIGINAL_ROWS(c,last,it,mx)
    state=c['d48'];windows=state.get('windows',[])
    rows=[('Автостоп: два последних окна',str(sum(bool(w.get('accepted')) for w in windows))+' / 2','2 подряд',state.get('ready',False))]
    for w in windows:
        rows.append(('Средний баланс '+str(w['it'][0])+'–'+str(w['it'][1])+', % Q',BASE.fmt(w['imb_pct'],'{:+.3f}'),'<1 по модулю',w['checks']['imb']))
    rows.append(('Баланс массы СВЗ', 'в допуске' if state.get('actual_mass_balance_ok') else 'не в допуске','≤1%',state.get('actual_mass_balance_ok',False)))
    if it and mx:rows.append(('Реальная итерация',str(it),'≤'+str(mx),it<mx))
    return rows

def show(self):
    ORIGINAL_SHOW(self)
    s=self.data or {}
    if s.get('run'):
        if s.get('d48'):
            label=self.boxes['prog'].cget('text')
            self.boxes['prog'].config(text=label+'\nавтостоп: два полных окна D-12a подряд')
        side=s.get('corrected_wall_sides')
        if side and side['dzv']['gas']!='interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite-shadow':
            label=self.boxes['mesh'].cget('text');self.boxes['mesh'].config(text=label+'\ny+ ДЗВ: нужен замер газовой стороны')
        self.head.config(text='Сейчас: '+str(s['run'].name)+' — Fluent работает; критерии ниже')
        self.fig.tight_layout();self.canvas.draw_idle()

BASE.current_run=current_run;BASE.snapshot=snapshot;BASE.conv_rows=conv_rows;BASE.App.show=show

def make_plan():
    if PLAN.exists():raise RuntimeError('GUI plan exists; do not overwrite')
    files=[Path(__file__),D/'author_gui.py',D/'audit_knurl_reports_1103_v3.py',D/'gui_runner.py',D/'passport.py']
    p=dict(made=AUD.now(),authorization='Author: restore current status and convergence display; reversible UI repair only.',scope='Read-only status UI. No solver/source-script edits, no CFD launches or changes.',root_cause='mtime of a long-open Windows transcript can remain unchanged longer than15min while iterations advance. Old GUI hid the active run by a900s mtime cutoff.',changes=['Identify active folder from exactly one live Fluent cx command journal inside runs. Keep the old discovery fallback for other cases.','Display actual residual iteration and closed-window D48 checks, both recent window balances, physical signed Q and recomputed effect. Mark invalid DZV yplus unknown, not0.','Use own params for geometry/mesh while a continued case points at a temporary template. Keep all other tabs.'],code_sha256={str(f):AUD.sha(f) for f in files})
    AUD.save(PLAN,p);PLAN.with_suffix('.sha256').write_text(AUD.sha(PLAN),encoding='ascii');print(PLAN,AUD.sha(PLAN))

def registered():
    if AUD.sha(PLAN)!=PLAN.with_suffix('.sha256').read_text().strip():raise RuntimeError('GUI plan changed')
    p=json.loads(PLAN.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    for f,h in p['code_sha256'].items():
        if AUD.sha(f)!=h:raise RuntimeError('GUI registered source changed '+f)

if __name__=='__main__':
    if sys.argv[1:]==['plan']:make_plan()
    elif sys.argv[1:]==['check']:
        registered();s=snapshot();print(json.dumps(dict(run=str(s.get('run')),iteration=(s.get('res')or{}).get('iter'),closed_iteration=(s.get('conv')or{}).get('checked_iteration'),D48=bool(s.get('d48')),Q=(s.get('last')or{}).get('Q'),effect=s.get('eff'),geometry=(s.get('pp')or{}).get('geometry')),ensure_ascii=False))
    else:
        registered();OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True,parents=True)
        if sys.stdout is None:sys.stdout=sys.stderr=open(OUT/'gui_log.txt','a',encoding='utf-8',buffering=1)
        app=BASE.App();app.title('Труба Леонтьева — интерфейс автора (текущий статус)')
        # Scroll long convergence tables without hiding the current values.
        parent=app.ctree.master;app.ctree.pack_forget();app.ctree.configure(height=10)
        scroll=BASE.ttk.Scrollbar(parent,orient='vertical',command=app.ctree.yview);scroll.pack(side='right',fill='y');app.ctree.configure(yscrollcommand=scroll.set);app.ctree.pack(side='left',fill='both',expand=True)
        app.geometry('1540x'+str(min(1100,app.winfo_screenheight()-80)))
        app.nb.select(2);app.mainloop()

"""Read-only status adapter for the existing author GUI. Original pinned files unchanged.
Prefer the live Fluent journal command over the mtime of its open transcript.
"""
import datetime,json,math,re,subprocess,sys,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
D=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(D));R=D.parent/'runs'
import author_gui as BASE
import audit_knurl_reports_1103_v3 as AUD
ORIGINAL_CURRENT=BASE.current_run;ORIGINAL_SNAPSHOT=BASE.snapshot;ORIGINAL_ROWS=BASE.conv_rows;ORIGINAL_SHOW=BASE.App.show
PLAN=R/'plans/интерфейс_статуса_1103_v2.json';OUT=R/'ui_status_1103_v2'

def resolve_live(rows):
    if isinstance(rows,dict):rows=[rows]
    rows=rows or []
    candidates=[]
    for row in rows:
        command=row.get('CommandLine') or ''
        m=re.search(r'(?:^|\s)-i\s+(?:"([^"]+\.jou)"|([^\s]+\.jou))',command,re.I)
        if not m:continue
        journal=Path(m[1] or m[2]).resolve()
        if journal.is_relative_to(R.resolve()) and journal.is_file():candidates.append((journal.parent,row))
    return candidates[0] if len(candidates)==1 else None

def live_run():
    command="@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name='cx2420.exe'\" | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine) | ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
    raw=subprocess.check_output(['powershell','-NoProfile','-Command',command],text=True,creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW).strip()
    return resolve_live(json.loads(raw) if raw else [])

def current_run():
    live=live_run()
    if live:return live[0],time.time()
    return None,None

def snapshot():
    s=ORIGINAL_SNAPSHOT();folder=s.get('run')
    active=[j for j in BASE.JQ.load() if j.get('status')=='идёт']
    if len(active)==1:
        job=active[0];s['active_job']=job
        stdout=R.parent/job.get('stdout','')
        statefile=stdout.parent/'state.json'
        state=json.loads(statefile.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if statefile.is_file() else {}
        if job.get('script','').endswith('_setup.py') or 'postprocess' in job.get('script','') or state.get('phase') in ('mesh','native_template'):
            s['preparation']=True;s['preparation_state']=state
            planmatch=re.match(r'^(.+?\.json)(?:\s|$)',job.get('plan',''))
            if planmatch and Path(planmatch[1]).is_file():
                plan=json.loads(Path(planmatch[1]).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
                matches=[c for c in plan.get('cases',[]) if c.get('tag')==state.get('tag')]
                if len(matches)==1:s['preparation_case']=matches[0]
    if not folder:return s
    folder=Path(folder);pp=s['pp'];enrich_passport(folder,pp)
    template=folder.parent/(folder.name+'_template')
    if folder.parent.name=='grid_1103_v8' and (template/'s5.trn').exists():
        side=AUD.sides(template);rows=AUD.samples(folder,side)
        by_it={r['iteration']:r for r in rows}
        for row in s['st'].get('samples',[]):
            if row['iteration'] in by_it:row['Q']=by_it[row['iteration']]['Q']
            if side['dzv']['gas']!='interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite-shadow':row['yp_dzv']=float('nan')
        s['last']=(s['st'].get('samples') or [None])[-1]
        s['eff']=BASE.effect(pp,s['last']) if s['last'] else None
        s['hist']=[(r['iteration'],BASE.effect(pp,r),r['Q'],r['m_dzv'],r['net']) for r in s['st'].get('samples',[])]
        if len(rows)>=3:
            e=AUD.evaluate(rows,pp['regime']);e.update(ok=e['accepted'],why='; '.join(k for k,v in e['checks'].items() if not v));s['d12a']=e
        else:s['d12a']=dict(ok=None,n=len(rows),why='ещё нет полного окна1000итераций')
        s['corrected_wall_sides']=side
    plan=R/'plans/проверка_сетки_1103_v9_автостоп.json'
    state=R/'autostop_d12a_1103_v2/state.json'
    if plan.exists() and state.exists():
        p=json.loads(plan.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if Path(p['target']).resolve()==folder.resolve():
            state=json.loads(state.read_text(encoding='utf-8'));s['d48']=state;s['conv']['d48']=state
    return s

def conv_rows(c,last,it,mx):
    if not (c or {}).get('d48'):return ORIGINAL_ROWS(c,last,it,mx)
    state=c['d48'];windows=state.get('windows',[])
    rows=[('Автостоп: два последних окна',str(sum(bool(w.get('accepted')) for w in windows))+' / 2','2 подряд',state.get('ready',False))]
