# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json,traceback,math,time,System
from Ansys.ACT.Interfaces.Common import SelectionTypeEnum
from Ansys.Mechanical.DataModel.Enums import SizingType,SizingBehavior,MethodType,PhaseType,BiasType,BiasOptionType
log=r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N03\setup.jsonl'
def record(step,value=None):
    with open(log,'a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'time':time.time(),'step':step,'value':value})+'\n');f.flush()
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model;geo=ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData
    ns={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    sections=('convergent','nozzle','heat','exit_contraction','exit_rounding','exit_recovery','exit_tail')
    for s in sections:
        for group in ('','_axial_edges','_layer_edges','_core_radial_edges'):
            assert 'MESH_'+s+group in ns
    record('scope preflight passed')
    model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference=System.Enum.Parse(model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference.GetType(),'CFD');model.Mesh.ElementSize=Quantity('0.5 [mm]')
    for b in model.Geometry.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.Body,True):
        name=str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]
        if name in ('air_svz','air_dzv','wall_abonite'):b.FluidSolidPhase=PhaseType.Solid if name=='wall_abonite' else PhaseType.LiquidGas
    record('CFD physics and gas/solid phases configured')
    for name,n in ns.items():
        if name.startswith('MESH_'):n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Structured_core']
    fm=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddFaceMeshing();fm.Name='Structured_core';fm.Location=ns['MESH_core_structured'].Location;fm.MappedMesh=True;fm.ConstrainBoundary=True
    record('face meshing configured')
    for section in sections:
        faces=[geo.GeoEntityById(i) for i in ns['MESH_'+section].Location.Ids]
        assert len(faces)==21 and all(len(f.Edges)==4 for f in faces)
        try:
            _v=json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N03\native_spec.json'))
        except Exception:
            _v={}
        _ax=float(_v.get('axial_size_m') or .0005);_conv=int(_v.get('convergent_div') or 200)
        # stage A3 (07.10.2026): divisions per geometric wall strip (20 strips, first 1 um) and core radial divisions
        _lay=int(_v.get('layer_div') or 1);_core=int(_v.get('core_div') or 70)
        axial=int(math.ceil(max(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Length for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges'].Location.Ids)/_ax))
        if section=='convergent':axial=_conv
        # 08.10.2026 (mesh v2): nozzle axial divisions with growth from the throat cell to the channel cell (no x10 jump);
        # convergent wall strips may keep a coarser split than the rest (inlet reversed flow on the fine mesh)
        _ndiv=int(_v.get('nozzle_div') or 0);_nbias=float(_v.get('nozzle_bias') or 0)
        if section=='nozzle' and _ndiv:axial=_ndiv
        _lay_s=int(_v.get('layer_div_convergent') or _lay) if section=='convergent' else _lay
        prefix='Nozzle_' if section=='nozzle' else 'Nozzle_'+section+'_'
        for suffix,group,count in (('axial','_axial_edges',axial),('layers','_layer_edges',_lay_s),('core_radial' if section=='nozzle' else 'radial','_core_radial_edges',_core)):
            name=prefix+suffix;old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)==name];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddSizing()
            o.Name=name;o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_'+section+group];o.Type=SizingType.NumberOfDivisions;o.NumberOfDivisions=count;o.Behavior=SizingBehavior.Hard
            if group=='_axial_edges':
                if section=='nozzle' and _nbias>1:
                    # same convention as the core radial bias below: small cells at the end of a non-reversed edge;
                    # keep edges that end at the throat (low x), reverse the others
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=_nbias
                    reverse=[i for i in o.Location.Ids if list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[0].X<list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[-1].X]
                    if reverse:
                        info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
                else:
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.NoBias
            if group=='_core_radial_edges':
                o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=100.
                reverse=[]
                for i in o.Location.Ids:
                    e=geo.GeoEntityById(i)
                    vertices=list(e.Vertices)
                    if vertices[0].Y>vertices[-1].Y:reverse.append(i)
                if reverse:
                    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
            record('sizing '+name,{'count':count,'ids':list(o.Location.Ids),'bias':str(o.BiasType)})
    bodies={str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]:b for a in geo.Assemblies for p in a.Parts for b in p.Bodies}
    gas_edges=set(e.Id for e in bodies['air_dzv'].Edges)
    wallids=sorted(gas_edges.intersection(set(i for n in ('wall_outer-air_dzv','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite') for i in ns[n].Location.Ids)))
    assert wallids
    old=[n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if str(n.Name)=='MESH_walls_dzv'];n=old[0] if old else model.AddNamedSelection();n.Name='MESH_walls_dzv'
    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=wallids;n.Location=info;n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Inflation_air_dzv'];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddInflation();o.Name='Inflation_air_dzv';o.NamedSelection=ns['air_dzv'];o.BoundaryNamedSelection=n
    o.InflationOption=1;o.FirstLayerHeight=Quantity('0.0001 [mm]');o.MaximumLayers=20;o.NumberOfLayers=20;o.GrowthRate=1.2
    record('DC inflation configured',{'walls':wallids,'h1_um':.1,'layers':20,'growth':1.2})
    for o in model.Mesh.Children:
        if str(o.Name)=='Core_quadrilateral_method':o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_core_structured']
    record('setup finished; no mesh generation yet')
except:record('python exception',traceback.format_exc())

    def _xy(i):
        vv=list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)
        return [round(vv[0].X*1e3,2),round(vv[0].Y*1e3,3),round(vv[-1].X*1e3,2),round(vv[-1].Y*1e3,3)]

    except:r['messages_error']=traceback.format_exc()[-300:]

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json,traceback,math,time,System
from Ansys.ACT.Interfaces.Common import SelectionTypeEnum
from Ansys.Mechanical.DataModel.Enums import SizingType,SizingBehavior,MethodType,PhaseType,BiasType,BiasOptionType
log=r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N04\setup.jsonl'
def record(step,value=None):
    with open(log,'a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'time':time.time(),'step':step,'value':value})+'\n');f.flush()
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model;geo=ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData
    ns={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    sections=('convergent','nozzle','heat','exit_contraction','exit_rounding','exit_recovery','exit_tail')
    for s in sections:
        for group in ('','_axial_edges','_layer_edges','_core_radial_edges'):
            assert 'MESH_'+s+group in ns
    record('scope preflight passed')
    model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference=System.Enum.Parse(model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference.GetType(),'CFD');model.Mesh.ElementSize=Quantity('0.5 [mm]')
    for b in model.Geometry.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.Body,True):
        name=str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]
        if name in ('air_svz','air_dzv','wall_abonite'):b.FluidSolidPhase=PhaseType.Solid if name=='wall_abonite' else PhaseType.LiquidGas
    record('CFD physics and gas/solid phases configured')
    for name,n in ns.items():
        if name.startswith('MESH_'):n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Structured_core']
    fm=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddFaceMeshing();fm.Name='Structured_core';fm.Location=ns['MESH_core_structured'].Location;fm.MappedMesh=True;fm.ConstrainBoundary=True
    record('face meshing configured')
    for section in sections:
        faces=[geo.GeoEntityById(i) for i in ns['MESH_'+section].Location.Ids]
        assert len(faces)==21 and all(len(f.Edges)==4 for f in faces)
        try:
            _v=json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N04\native_spec.json'))
        except Exception:
            _v={}
        _ax=float(_v.get('axial_size_m') or .0005);_conv=int(_v.get('convergent_div') or 200)
        # stage A3 (07.10.2026): divisions per geometric wall strip (20 strips, first 1 um) and core radial divisions
        _lay=int(_v.get('layer_div') or 1);_core=int(_v.get('core_div') or 70)
        axial=int(math.ceil(max(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Length for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges'].Location.Ids)/_ax))
        if section=='convergent':axial=_conv
        # 08.10.2026 (mesh v2): nozzle axial divisions with growth from the throat cell to the channel cell (no x10 jump);
        # convergent wall strips may keep a coarser split than the rest (inlet reversed flow on the fine mesh)
        _ndiv=int(_v.get('nozzle_div') or 0);_nbias=float(_v.get('nozzle_bias') or 0)
        if section=='nozzle' and _ndiv:axial=_ndiv
        _lay_s=int(_v.get('layer_div_convergent') or _lay) if section=='convergent' else _lay
        prefix='Nozzle_' if section=='nozzle' else 'Nozzle_'+section+'_'
        for suffix,group,count in (('axial','_axial_edges',axial),('layers','_layer_edges',_lay_s),('core_radial' if section=='nozzle' else 'radial','_core_radial_edges',_core)):
            name=prefix+suffix;old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)==name];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddSizing()
            o.Name=name;o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_'+section+group];o.Type=SizingType.NumberOfDivisions;o.NumberOfDivisions=count;o.Behavior=SizingBehavior.Hard
            if group=='_axial_edges':
                if section=='nozzle' and _nbias>1:
                    # same convention as the core radial bias below: small cells at the end of a non-reversed edge;
                    # keep edges that end at the throat (low x), reverse the others
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=_nbias
                    reverse=[i for i in o.Location.Ids if list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[0].X<list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[-1].X]
                    if reverse:
                        info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
                else:
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.NoBias
            if group=='_core_radial_edges':
                o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=100.
                reverse=[]
                for i in o.Location.Ids:
                    e=geo.GeoEntityById(i)
                    vertices=list(e.Vertices)
                    if vertices[0].Y>vertices[-1].Y:reverse.append(i)
                if reverse:
                    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
            record('sizing '+name,{'count':count,'ids':list(o.Location.Ids),'bias':str(o.BiasType)})
    bodies={str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]:b for a in geo.Assemblies for p in a.Parts for b in p.Bodies}
    gas_edges=set(e.Id for e in bodies['air_dzv'].Edges)
    wallids=sorted(gas_edges.intersection(set(i for n in ('wall_outer-air_dzv','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite') for i in ns[n].Location.Ids)))
    assert wallids
    old=[n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if str(n.Name)=='MESH_walls_dzv'];n=old[0] if old else model.AddNamedSelection();n.Name='MESH_walls_dzv'
    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=wallids;n.Location=info;n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Inflation_air_dzv'];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddInflation();o.Name='Inflation_air_dzv';o.NamedSelection=ns['air_dzv'];o.BoundaryNamedSelection=n
    o.InflationOption=1;o.FirstLayerHeight=Quantity('0.0001 [mm]');o.MaximumLayers=20;o.NumberOfLayers=20;o.GrowthRate=1.2
    record('DC inflation configured',{'walls':wallids,'h1_um':.1,'layers':20,'growth':1.2})
    for o in model.Mesh.Children:
        if str(o.Name)=='Core_quadrilateral_method':o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_core_structured']
    record('setup finished; no mesh generation yet')
except:record('python exception',traceback.format_exc())

    r['geometry_bodies']=[{'name':str(b.Name),'edges':len(list(b.Edges)),'faces':len(list(b.Faces))} for b in bodies.values()]
    r['elements']=model.Mesh.Elements;r['nodes']=model.Mesh.Nodes;r['gen_seconds']=time.time()-t0
    r['bodies_after_mesh']=_bodies_state()

    def _xy(i):
        vv=list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)
        return [round(vv[0].X*1e3,2),round(vv[0].Y*1e3,3),round(vv[-1].X*1e3,2),round(vv[-1].Y*1e3,3)]

        r['messages']=[str(m.DisplayString)[:300] for m in ExtAPI.Application.Messages][-15:]
    except:r['messages_error']=traceback.format_exc()[-300:]

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json,traceback,math,time,System
from Ansys.ACT.Interfaces.Common import SelectionTypeEnum
from Ansys.Mechanical.DataModel.Enums import SizingType,SizingBehavior,MethodType,PhaseType,BiasType,BiasOptionType
log=r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N05\setup.jsonl'
def record(step,value=None):
    with open(log,'a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'time':time.time(),'step':step,'value':value})+'\n');f.flush()
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model;geo=ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData
    ns={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    sections=('convergent','nozzle','heat','exit_contraction','exit_rounding','exit_recovery','exit_tail')
    for s in sections:
        for group in ('','_axial_edges','_layer_edges','_core_radial_edges'):
            assert 'MESH_'+s+group in ns
    record('scope preflight passed')
    model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference=System.Enum.Parse(model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference.GetType(),'CFD');model.Mesh.ElementSize=Quantity('0.5 [mm]')
    for b in model.Geometry.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.Body,True):
        name=str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]
        if name in ('air_svz','air_dzv','wall_abonite'):b.FluidSolidPhase=PhaseType.Solid if name=='wall_abonite' else PhaseType.LiquidGas
    record('CFD physics and gas/solid phases configured')
    for name,n in ns.items():
        if name.startswith('MESH_'):n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Structured_core']
    fm=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddFaceMeshing();fm.Name='Structured_core';fm.Location=ns['MESH_core_structured'].Location;fm.MappedMesh=True;fm.ConstrainBoundary=True
    record('face meshing configured')
    for section in sections:
        faces=[geo.GeoEntityById(i) for i in ns['MESH_'+section].Location.Ids]
        assert len(faces)==21 and all(len(f.Edges)==4 for f in faces)
        try:
            _v=json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N05\native_spec.json'))
        except Exception:
            _v={}
        _ax=float(_v.get('axial_size_m') or .0005);_conv=int(_v.get('convergent_div') or 200)
        # stage A3 (07.10.2026): divisions per geometric wall strip (20 strips, first 1 um) and core radial divisions
        _lay=int(_v.get('layer_div') or 1);_core=int(_v.get('core_div') or 70)
        axial=int(math.ceil(max(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Length for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges'].Location.Ids)/_ax))
        if section=='convergent':axial=_conv
        # 08.10.2026 (mesh v2): nozzle axial divisions with growth from the throat cell to the channel cell (no x10 jump);
        # convergent wall strips may keep a coarser split than the rest (inlet reversed flow on the fine mesh)
        _ndiv=int(_v.get('nozzle_div') or 0);_nbias=float(_v.get('nozzle_bias') or 0)
        if section=='nozzle' and _ndiv:axial=_ndiv
        _lay_s=int(_v.get('layer_div_convergent') or _lay) if section=='convergent' else _lay
        prefix='Nozzle_' if section=='nozzle' else 'Nozzle_'+section+'_'
        for suffix,group,count in (('axial','_axial_edges',axial),('layers','_layer_edges',_lay_s),('core_radial' if section=='nozzle' else 'radial','_core_radial_edges',_core)):
            name=prefix+suffix;old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)==name];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddSizing()
            o.Name=name;o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_'+section+group];o.Type=SizingType.NumberOfDivisions;o.NumberOfDivisions=count;o.Behavior=SizingBehavior.Hard
            if group=='_axial_edges':
                if section=='nozzle' and _nbias>1:
                    # same convention as the core radial bias below: small cells at the end of a non-reversed edge;
                    # keep edges that end at the throat (low x), reverse the others
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=_nbias
                    reverse=[i for i in o.Location.Ids if list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[0].X<list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[-1].X]
                    if reverse:
                        info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
                else:
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.NoBias
            if group=='_core_radial_edges':
                o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=100.
                reverse=[]
                for i in o.Location.Ids:
                    e=geo.GeoEntityById(i)
                    vertices=list(e.Vertices)
                    if vertices[0].Y>vertices[-1].Y:reverse.append(i)
                if reverse:
                    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
            record('sizing '+name,{'count':count,'ids':list(o.Location.Ids),'bias':str(o.BiasType)})
    bodies={str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]:b for a in geo.Assemblies for p in a.Parts for b in p.Bodies}
    gas_edges=set(e.Id for e in bodies['air_dzv'].Edges)
    wallids=sorted(gas_edges.intersection(set(i for n in ('wall_outer-air_dzv','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite') for i in ns[n].Location.Ids)))
    assert wallids
    old=[n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if str(n.Name)=='MESH_walls_dzv'];n=old[0] if old else model.AddNamedSelection();n.Name='MESH_walls_dzv'
    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=wallids;n.Location=info;n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Inflation_air_dzv'];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddInflation();o.Name='Inflation_air_dzv';o.NamedSelection=ns['air_dzv'];o.BoundaryNamedSelection=n
    o.InflationOption=1;o.FirstLayerHeight=Quantity('0.0001 [mm]');o.MaximumLayers=20;o.NumberOfLayers=20;o.GrowthRate=1.2
    record('DC inflation configured',{'walls':wallids,'h1_um':.1,'layers':20,'growth':1.2})
    for o in model.Mesh.Children:
        if str(o.Name)=='Core_quadrilateral_method':o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_core_structured']
    record('setup finished; no mesh generation yet')
except:record('python exception',traceback.format_exc())

            except:pass
            try:d['divisions']=int(o.NumberOfDivisions)
            except:pass
            try:d['suppressed']=str(o.Suppressed)
            except:pass
            _mc.append(d)
        r['mesh_controls']=_mc
    except:r['mesh_controls']=traceback.format_exc()[-200:]
    try:
        import System
        _p=System.Diagnostics.Process.GetCurrentProcess();r['memory_mb']={'working_set':_p.WorkingSet64/1048576,'peak_working_set':_p.PeakWorkingSet64/1048576}
    except:r['memory_mb']=traceback.format_exc()[-200:]
    # success = EVERY body has elements (KS1_04 / D0: air_dzv had 0 cells, mesher crash, but 'passed') and both contact
    # regions have non-empty source and target
    _zero=[]
    try:
        for d in r['bodies_after_mesh']:
            if int(str(d.get('Elements','0')).split()[0])<=0:_zero.append(d['name'])
    except:_zero=['bodies check failed: '+traceback.format_exc()[-150:]]
    r['bodies_without_elements']=_zero
    try:
        _crs=[(str(cr.Name),len(list(cr.SourceLocation.Ids)),len(list(cr.TargetLocation.Ids))) for cr in model.Connections.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.ContactRegion,True)]
        r['contacts_ok']=any(c[0]=='Contact Region' and c[1]>0 and c[2]>0 for c in _crs) and any(c[0]=='Contact Region 2' and c[1]>0 and c[2]>0 for c in _crs)
        r['contact_regions_count']=len(_crs)
    except:r['contacts_ok']=False;r['contacts_check_error']=traceback.format_exc()[-200:]
    try:
        r['contacts_all']=[(str(cr.Name),len(list(cr.SourceLocation.Ids)),len(list(cr.TargetLocation.Ids))) for cr in model.Connections.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.ContactRegion,True)]
    except:r['contacts_all']=traceback.format_exc()[-200:]
    def _xy(i):
        vv=list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)
        return [round(vv[0].X*1e3,2),round(vv[0].Y*1e3,3),round(vv[-1].X*1e3,2),round(vv[-1].Y*1e3,3)]
    def _owner(i):
        return [k for k,b in bodies.items() if i in set(e.Id for e in b.Edges)]
    try:   # 15.10: contact scoping before export (edge coords mm + owner body)
        r['contacts_before']=[(str(cr.Name),[(i,_xy(i),_owner(i)) for i in cr.SourceLocation.Ids][:3],len(list(cr.SourceLocation.Ids)),
                               [(i,_xy(i),_owner(i)) for i in cr.TargetLocation.Ids][:3],len(list(cr.TargetLocation.Ids)))
                              for cr in model.Connections.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.ContactRegion,True)][:6]
    except:r['contacts_before']=traceback.format_exc()[-300:]
    if r['messages_after_mesh'] or r['bodies_without_elements'] or r['contact_regions_count']!=2 or not r['contacts_ok']:
        raise Exception('Native mesh gate: messages, empty body or contacts')
    if not all(d.get('ObjectState')=='Meshed' for d in r['bodies_after_mesh']):
        raise Exception('Body not fully meshed')
    model.Mesh.InternalObject.WriteFluentInputFile(msh);r['exported']=msh
    r['passed']=r['elements']>0 and not r.get('bodies_without_elements') and bool(r.get('contacts_ok'))
except:
    r['error']=traceback.format_exc();r['passed']=False
    try:   # 15.10: Mechanical messages for a failed export (COM E_FAIL on some geometries)
        r['messages']=[str(m.DisplayString)[:300] for m in ExtAPI.Application.Messages][-15:]
    except:r['messages_error']=traceback.format_exc()[-300:]
with open(out,'w') as f:f.write(json.dumps(r,indent=1))

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json,traceback,math,time,System
from Ansys.ACT.Interfaces.Common import SelectionTypeEnum
from Ansys.Mechanical.DataModel.Enums import SizingType,SizingBehavior,MethodType,PhaseType,BiasType,BiasOptionType
log=r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N06\setup.jsonl'
def record(step,value=None):
    with open(log,'a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'time':time.time(),'step':step,'value':value})+'\n');f.flush()
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model;geo=ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData
    ns={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    sections=('convergent','nozzle','heat','exit_contraction','exit_rounding','exit_recovery','exit_tail')
    for s in sections:
        for group in ('','_axial_edges','_layer_edges','_core_radial_edges'):
            assert 'MESH_'+s+group in ns
    record('scope preflight passed')
    model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference=System.Enum.Parse(model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference.GetType(),'CFD');model.Mesh.ElementSize=Quantity('0.5 [mm]')
    for b in model.Geometry.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.Body,True):
        name=str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]
        if name in ('air_svz','air_dzv','wall_abonite'):b.FluidSolidPhase=PhaseType.Solid if name=='wall_abonite' else PhaseType.LiquidGas
    record('CFD physics and gas/solid phases configured')
    for name,n in ns.items():
        if name.startswith('MESH_'):n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Structured_core']
    fm=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddFaceMeshing();fm.Name='Structured_core';fm.Location=ns['MESH_core_structured'].Location;fm.MappedMesh=True;fm.ConstrainBoundary=True
    record('face meshing configured')
    for section in sections:
        faces=[geo.GeoEntityById(i) for i in ns['MESH_'+section].Location.Ids]
        assert len(faces)==21 and all(len(f.Edges)==4 for f in faces)
        try:
            _v=json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N06\native_spec.json'))
        except Exception:
            _v={}
        _ax=float(_v.get('axial_size_m') or .0005);_conv=int(_v.get('convergent_div') or 200)
        # stage A3 (07.10.2026): divisions per geometric wall strip (20 strips, first 1 um) and core radial divisions
        _lay=int(_v.get('layer_div') or 1);_core=int(_v.get('core_div') or 70)
        axial=int(math.ceil(max(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Length for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges'].Location.Ids)/_ax))
        if section=='convergent':axial=_conv
        # 08.10.2026 (mesh v2): nozzle axial divisions with growth from the throat cell to the channel cell (no x10 jump);
        # convergent wall strips may keep a coarser split than the rest (inlet reversed flow on the fine mesh)
        _ndiv=int(_v.get('nozzle_div') or 0);_nbias=float(_v.get('nozzle_bias') or 0)
        if section=='nozzle' and _ndiv:axial=_ndiv
        _lay_s=int(_v.get('layer_div_convergent') or _lay) if section=='convergent' else _lay
        prefix='Nozzle_' if section=='nozzle' else 'Nozzle_'+section+'_'
        for suffix,group,count in (('axial','_axial_edges',axial),('layers','_layer_edges',_lay_s),('core_radial' if section=='nozzle' else 'radial','_core_radial_edges',_core)):
            name=prefix+suffix;old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)==name];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddSizing()
            o.Name=name;o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_'+section+group];o.Type=SizingType.NumberOfDivisions;o.NumberOfDivisions=count;o.Behavior=SizingBehavior.Hard
            if group=='_axial_edges':
                if section=='nozzle' and _nbias>1:
                    # same convention as the core radial bias below: small cells at the end of a non-reversed edge;
                    # keep edges that end at the throat (low x), reverse the others
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=_nbias
                    reverse=[i for i in o.Location.Ids if list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[0].X<list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[-1].X]
                    if reverse:
                        info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
                else:
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.NoBias
            if group=='_core_radial_edges':
                o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=100.
                reverse=[]
                for i in o.Location.Ids:
                    e=geo.GeoEntityById(i)
                    vertices=list(e.Vertices)
                    if vertices[0].Y>vertices[-1].Y:reverse.append(i)
                if reverse:
                    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
            record('sizing '+name,{'count':count,'ids':list(o.Location.Ids),'bias':str(o.BiasType)})
    bodies={str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]:b for a in geo.Assemblies for p in a.Parts for b in p.Bodies}
    gas_edges=set(e.Id for e in bodies['air_dzv'].Edges)
    wallids=sorted(gas_edges.intersection(set(i for n in ('wall_outer-air_dzv','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite') for i in ns[n].Location.Ids)))
    assert wallids
    old=[n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if str(n.Name)=='MESH_walls_dzv'];n=old[0] if old else model.AddNamedSelection();n.Name='MESH_walls_dzv'
    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=wallids;n.Location=info;n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Inflation_air_dzv'];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddInflation();o.Name='Inflation_air_dzv';o.NamedSelection=ns['air_dzv'];o.BoundaryNamedSelection=n
    o.InflationOption=1;o.FirstLayerHeight=Quantity('0.0001 [mm]');o.MaximumLayers=20;o.NumberOfLayers=20;o.GrowthRate=1.2
    record('DC inflation configured',{'walls':wallids,'h1_um':.1,'layers':20,'growth':1.2})
    for o in model.Mesh.Children:
        if str(o.Name)=='Core_quadrilateral_method':o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_core_structured']
    record('setup finished; no mesh generation yet')
except:record('python exception',traceback.format_exc())

        raise Exception('Native mesh gate: messages, empty body or contacts')
    if not all(d.get('ObjectState')=='Meshed' for d in r['bodies_after_mesh']):
        raise Exception('Body not fully meshed')
    model.Mesh.InternalObject.WriteFluentInputFile(msh);r['exported']=msh
    r['passed']=r['elements']>0 and not r.get('bodies_without_elements') and bool(r.get('contacts_ok'))
except:
    r['error']=traceback.format_exc();r['passed']=False
    try:   # 15.10: Mechanical messages for a failed export (COM E_FAIL on some geometries)
        r['messages']=[str(m.DisplayString)[:300] for m in ExtAPI.Application.Messages][-15:]
    except:r['messages_error']=traceback.format_exc()[-300:]
with open(out,'w') as f:f.write(json.dumps(r,indent=1))

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json,traceback,math,time,System
from Ansys.ACT.Interfaces.Common import SelectionTypeEnum
from Ansys.Mechanical.DataModel.Enums import SizingType,SizingBehavior,MethodType,PhaseType,BiasType,BiasOptionType
log=r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N07\setup.jsonl'
def record(step,value=None):
    with open(log,'a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'time':time.time(),'step':step,'value':value})+'\n');f.flush()
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model;geo=ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData
    ns={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    sections=('convergent','nozzle','heat','exit_contraction','exit_rounding','exit_recovery','exit_tail')
    for s in sections:
        for group in ('','_axial_edges','_layer_edges','_core_radial_edges'):
            assert 'MESH_'+s+group in ns
    record('scope preflight passed')
    model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference=System.Enum.Parse(model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference.GetType(),'CFD');model.Mesh.ElementSize=Quantity('0.5 [mm]')
    for b in model.Geometry.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.Body,True):
        name=str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]
        if name in ('air_svz','air_dzv','wall_abonite'):b.FluidSolidPhase=PhaseType.Solid if name=='wall_abonite' else PhaseType.LiquidGas
    record('CFD physics and gas/solid phases configured')
    for name,n in ns.items():
        if name.startswith('MESH_'):n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Structured_core']
    fm=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddFaceMeshing();fm.Name='Structured_core';fm.Location=ns['MESH_core_structured'].Location;fm.MappedMesh=True;fm.ConstrainBoundary=True
    record('face meshing configured')
    for section in sections:
        faces=[geo.GeoEntityById(i) for i in ns['MESH_'+section].Location.Ids]
        assert len(faces)==21 and all(len(f.Edges)==4 for f in faces)
        try:
            _v=json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N07\native_spec.json'))
        except Exception:
            _v={}
        _ax=float(_v.get('axial_size_m') or .0005);_conv=int(_v.get('convergent_div') or 200)
        # stage A3 (07.10.2026): divisions per geometric wall strip (20 strips, first 1 um) and core radial divisions
        _lay=int(_v.get('layer_div') or 1);_core=int(_v.get('core_div') or 70)
        axial=int(math.ceil(max(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Length for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges'].Location.Ids)/_ax))
        if section=='convergent':axial=_conv
        # 08.10.2026 (mesh v2): nozzle axial divisions with growth from the throat cell to the channel cell (no x10 jump);
        # convergent wall strips may keep a coarser split than the rest (inlet reversed flow on the fine mesh)
        _ndiv=int(_v.get('nozzle_div') or 0);_nbias=float(_v.get('nozzle_bias') or 0)
        if section=='nozzle' and _ndiv:axial=_ndiv
        _lay_s=int(_v.get('layer_div_convergent') or _lay) if section=='convergent' else _lay
        prefix='Nozzle_' if section=='nozzle' else 'Nozzle_'+section+'_'
        for suffix,group,count in (('axial','_axial_edges',axial),('layers','_layer_edges',_lay_s),('core_radial' if section=='nozzle' else 'radial','_core_radial_edges',_core)):
            name=prefix+suffix;old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)==name];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddSizing()
            o.Name=name;o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_'+section+group];o.Type=SizingType.NumberOfDivisions;o.NumberOfDivisions=count;o.Behavior=SizingBehavior.Hard
            if group=='_axial_edges':
                if section=='nozzle' and _nbias>1:
                    # same convention as the core radial bias below: small cells at the end of a non-reversed edge;
                    # keep edges that end at the throat (low x), reverse the others
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=_nbias
                    reverse=[i for i in o.Location.Ids if list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[0].X<list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[-1].X]
                    if reverse:
                        info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
                else:
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.NoBias
            if group=='_core_radial_edges':
                o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=100.
                reverse=[]
                for i in o.Location.Ids:
                    e=geo.GeoEntityById(i)
                    vertices=list(e.Vertices)
                    if vertices[0].Y>vertices[-1].Y:reverse.append(i)
                if reverse:
                    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
            record('sizing '+name,{'count':count,'ids':list(o.Location.Ids),'bias':str(o.BiasType)})
    bodies={str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]:b for a in geo.Assemblies for p in a.Parts for b in p.Bodies}
    gas_edges=set(e.Id for e in bodies['air_dzv'].Edges)
    wallids=sorted(gas_edges.intersection(set(i for n in ('wall_outer-air_dzv','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite') for i in ns[n].Location.Ids)))
    assert wallids
    old=[n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if str(n.Name)=='MESH_walls_dzv'];n=old[0] if old else model.AddNamedSelection();n.Name='MESH_walls_dzv'
    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=wallids;n.Location=info;n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Inflation_air_dzv'];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddInflation();o.Name='Inflation_air_dzv';o.NamedSelection=ns['air_dzv'];o.BoundaryNamedSelection=n
    o.InflationOption=1;o.FirstLayerHeight=Quantity('0.0001 [mm]');o.MaximumLayers=20;o.NumberOfLayers=20;o.GrowthRate=1.2
    record('DC inflation configured',{'walls':wallids,'h1_um':.1,'layers':20,'growth':1.2})
    for o in model.Mesh.Children:
        if str(o.Name)=='Core_quadrilateral_method':o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_core_structured']
    record('setup finished; no mesh generation yet')
except:record('python exception',traceback.format_exc())

        mc=GetSystem(Name='SYS').GetContainer(ComponentName='Mesh')

        mc.SendCommand(Language='Python',Command=r"execfile(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N08\mesh_native.py')")
        try: mc.Exit()
        except Exception as e: r['exit_note']=str(e)

        # the previous one's state (accumulated 'Contact Region 2' duplicates). Builds run on a fresh copy of the reference
        # project (run_dataset.build_mesh); the mesh is already exported by mesh_variant.py.
        r['save_note']='not saved (02.11.2026)'
        r['passed']=True

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json,traceback,math,time,System
from Ansys.ACT.Interfaces.Common import SelectionTypeEnum
from Ansys.Mechanical.DataModel.Enums import SizingType,SizingBehavior,MethodType,PhaseType,BiasType,BiasOptionType
log=r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N08\setup.jsonl'
def record(step,value=None):
    with open(log,'a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'time':time.time(),'step':step,'value':value})+'\n');f.flush()
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model;geo=ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData
    ns={str(n.Name):n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if list(n.Location.Ids)}
    sections=('convergent','nozzle','heat','exit_contraction','exit_rounding','exit_recovery','exit_tail')
    for s in sections:
        for group in ('','_axial_edges','_layer_edges','_core_radial_edges'):
            assert 'MESH_'+s+group in ns
    record('scope preflight passed')
    model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference=System.Enum.Parse(model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference.GetType(),'CFD');model.Mesh.ElementSize=Quantity('0.5 [mm]')
    for b in model.Geometry.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.Body,True):
        name=str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]
        if name in ('air_svz','air_dzv','wall_abonite'):b.FluidSolidPhase=PhaseType.Solid if name=='wall_abonite' else PhaseType.LiquidGas
    record('CFD physics and gas/solid phases configured')
    for name,n in ns.items():
        if name.startswith('MESH_'):n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Structured_core']
    fm=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddFaceMeshing();fm.Name='Structured_core';fm.Location=ns['MESH_core_structured'].Location;fm.MappedMesh=True;fm.ConstrainBoundary=True
    record('face meshing configured')
    for section in sections:
        faces=[geo.GeoEntityById(i) for i in ns['MESH_'+section].Location.Ids]
        assert len(faces)==21 and all(len(f.Edges)==4 for f in faces)
        try:
            _v=json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N08\native_spec.json'))
        except Exception:
            _v={}
        _ax=float(_v.get('axial_size_m') or .0005);_conv=int(_v.get('convergent_div') or 200)
        # stage A3 (07.10.2026): divisions per geometric wall strip (20 strips, first 1 um) and core radial divisions
        _lay=int(_v.get('layer_div') or 1);_core=int(_v.get('core_div') or 70)
        axial=int(math.ceil(max(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Length for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges'].Location.Ids)/_ax))
        if section=='convergent':axial=_conv
        # 08.10.2026 (mesh v2): nozzle axial divisions with growth from the throat cell to the channel cell (no x10 jump);
        # convergent wall strips may keep a coarser split than the rest (inlet reversed flow on the fine mesh)
        _ndiv=int(_v.get('nozzle_div') or 0);_nbias=float(_v.get('nozzle_bias') or 0)
        if section=='nozzle' and _ndiv:axial=_ndiv
        _lay_s=int(_v.get('layer_div_convergent') or _lay) if section=='convergent' else _lay
        prefix='Nozzle_' if section=='nozzle' else 'Nozzle_'+section+'_'
        for suffix,group,count in (('axial','_axial_edges',axial),('layers','_layer_edges',_lay_s),('core_radial' if section=='nozzle' else 'radial','_core_radial_edges',_core)):
            name=prefix+suffix;old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)==name];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddSizing()
            o.Name=name;o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_'+section+group];o.Type=SizingType.NumberOfDivisions;o.NumberOfDivisions=count;o.Behavior=SizingBehavior.Hard
            if group=='_axial_edges':
                if section=='nozzle' and _nbias>1:
                    # same convention as the core radial bias below: small cells at the end of a non-reversed edge;
                    # keep edges that end at the throat (low x), reverse the others
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=_nbias
                    reverse=[i for i in o.Location.Ids if list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[0].X<list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[-1].X]
                    if reverse:
                        info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
                else:
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.NoBias
            if group=='_core_radial_edges':
                o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=100.
                reverse=[]
                for i in o.Location.Ids:
                    e=geo.GeoEntityById(i)
                    vertices=list(e.Vertices)
                    if vertices[0].Y>vertices[-1].Y:reverse.append(i)
                if reverse:
                    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
            record('sizing '+name,{'count':count,'ids':list(o.Location.Ids),'bias':str(o.BiasType)})
    bodies={str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]:b for a in geo.Assemblies for p in a.Parts for b in p.Bodies}
    gas_edges=set(e.Id for e in bodies['air_dzv'].Edges)
    wallids=sorted(gas_edges.intersection(set(i for n in ('wall_outer-air_dzv','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite') for i in ns[n].Location.Ids)))
    assert wallids
    old=[n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if str(n.Name)=='MESH_walls_dzv'];n=old[0] if old else model.AddNamedSelection();n.Name='MESH_walls_dzv'
    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=wallids;n.Location=info;n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Inflation_air_dzv'];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddInflation();o.Name='Inflation_air_dzv';o.NamedSelection=ns['air_dzv'];o.BoundaryNamedSelection=n
    o.InflationOption=1;o.FirstLayerHeight=Quantity('0.0001 [mm]');o.MaximumLayers=20;o.NumberOfLayers=20;o.GrowthRate=1.2
    record('DC inflation configured',{'walls':wallids,'h1_um':.1,'layers':20,'growth':1.2})
    for o in model.Mesh.Children:
        if str(o.Name)=='Core_quadrilateral_method':o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_core_structured']
    record('setup finished; no mesh generation yet')
except:record('python exception',traceback.format_exc())

    fm=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddFaceMeshing();fm.Name='Structured_core';fm.Location=ns['MESH_core_structured'].Location;fm.MappedMesh=True;fm.ConstrainBoundary=True
    record('face meshing configured')
    for section in sections:
        faces=[geo.GeoEntityById(i) for i in ns['MESH_'+section].Location.Ids]
        assert len(faces)==21 and all(len(f.Edges)==4 for f in faces)
        try:
            _v=json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N09\native_spec.json'))
        except Exception:
            _v={}
        _ax=float(_v.get('axial_size_m') or .0005);_conv=int(_v.get('convergent_div') or 200)
        # stage A3 (07.10.2026): divisions per geometric wall strip (20 strips, first 1 um) and core radial divisions
        _lay=int(_v.get('layer_div') or 1);_core=int(_v.get('core_div') or 70)
        axial=int(math.ceil(max(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Length for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges'].Location.Ids)/_ax))
        if section=='convergent':axial=_conv
        # 08.10.2026 (mesh v2): nozzle axial divisions with growth from the throat cell to the channel cell (no x10 jump);
        # convergent wall strips may keep a coarser split than the rest (inlet reversed flow on the fine mesh)
        _ndiv=int(_v.get('nozzle_div') or 0);_nbias=float(_v.get('nozzle_bias') or 0)
        if section=='nozzle' and _ndiv:axial=_ndiv
        _lay_s=int(_v.get('layer_div_convergent') or _lay) if section=='convergent' else _lay
        prefix='Nozzle_' if section=='nozzle' else 'Nozzle_'+section+'_'
        for suffix,group,count in (('axial','_axial_edges',axial),('layers','_layer_edges',_lay_s),('core_radial' if section=='nozzle' else 'radial','_core_radial_edges',_core)):
            name=prefix+suffix;old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)==name];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddSizing()
            o.Name=name;o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_'+section+group];o.Type=SizingType.NumberOfDivisions;o.NumberOfDivisions=count;o.Behavior=SizingBehavior.Hard
            if group=='_axial_edges':
                if section=='nozzle' and _nbias>1:
                    # same convention as the core radial bias below: small cells at the end of a non-reversed edge;
                    # keep edges that end at the throat (low x), reverse the others
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=_nbias
                    reverse=[i for i in o.Location.Ids if list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[0].X<list(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Vertices)[-1].X]
                    if reverse:
                        info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
                else:
                    o.BiasType=BiasType.NoBias
            if group=='_core_radial_edges':
                o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=100.
                reverse=[]
                for i in o.Location.Ids:
                    e=geo.GeoEntityById(i)
                    vertices=list(e.Vertices)
                    if vertices[0].Y>vertices[-1].Y:reverse.append(i)
                if reverse:
                    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
            record('sizing '+name,{'count':count,'ids':list(o.Location.Ids),'bias':str(o.BiasType)})
    bodies={str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]:b for a in geo.Assemblies for p in a.Parts for b in p.Bodies}
    gas_edges=set(e.Id for e in bodies['air_dzv'].Edges)
    wallids=sorted(gas_edges.intersection(set(i for n in ('wall_outer-air_dzv','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite') for i in ns[n].Location.Ids)))
    assert wallids
    old=[n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if str(n.Name)=='MESH_walls_dzv'];n=old[0] if old else model.AddNamedSelection();n.Name='MESH_walls_dzv'
    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=wallids;n.Location=info;n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Inflation_air_dzv'];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddInflation();o.Name='Inflation_air_dzv';o.NamedSelection=ns['air_dzv'];o.BoundaryNamedSelection=n
    o.InflationOption=1;o.FirstLayerHeight=Quantity('0.0001 [mm]');o.MaximumLayers=20;o.NumberOfLayers=20;o.GrowthRate=1.2
    record('DC inflation configured',{'walls':wallids,'h1_um':.1,'layers':20,'growth':1.2})
    for o in model.Mesh.Children:
        if str(o.Name)=='Core_quadrilateral_method':o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_core_structured']
    record('setup finished; no mesh generation yet')
except:record('python exception',traceback.format_exc())

import json,traceback,math,time,System

def record(step,value=None):
    with open(log,'a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'time':time.time(),'step':step,'value':value})+'\n');f.flush()
try:
    model=ExtAPI.DataModel.Project.Model;geo=ExtAPI.DataModel.GeoData

    for s in sections:
        for group in ('','_axial_edges','_layer_edges','_core_radial_edges'):
            assert 'MESH_'+s+group in ns
    record('scope preflight passed')
    model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference=System.Enum.Parse(model.Mesh.PhysicsPreference.GetType(),'CFD');model.Mesh.ElementSize=Quantity('0.5 [mm]')
    for b in model.Geometry.GetChildren(DataModelObjectCategory.Body,True):
        name=str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]
        if name in ('air_svz','air_dzv','wall_abonite'):b.FluidSolidPhase=PhaseType.Solid if name=='wall_abonite' else PhaseType.LiquidGas
    record('CFD physics and gas/solid phases configured')
    for name,n in ns.items():
        if name.startswith('MESH_'):n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Structured_core']
    fm=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddFaceMeshing();fm.Name='Structured_core';fm.Location=ns['MESH_core_structured'].Location;fm.MappedMesh=True;fm.ConstrainBoundary=True
    record('face meshing configured')
    for section in sections:
        faces=[geo.GeoEntityById(i) for i in ns['MESH_'+section].Location.Ids]
        assert len(faces)==21 and all(len(f.Edges)==4 for f in faces)
        try:
            _v=json.load(open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\runs\knurl_dataset_queue_1104_v1\native\N10\native_spec.json'))
        except Exception:
            _v={}
        _ax=float(_v.get('axial_size_m') or .0005);_conv=int(_v.get('convergent_div') or 200)
        # stage A3 (07.10.2026): divisions per geometric wall strip (20 strips, first 1 um) and core radial divisions
        _lay=int(_v.get('layer_div') or 1);_core=int(_v.get('core_div') or 70)
        axial=int(math.ceil(max(geo.GeoEntityById(i).Length for i in ns['MESH_'+section+'_axial_edges'].Location.Ids)/_ax))
        if section=='convergent':axial=_conv
        # 08.10.2026 (mesh v2): nozzle axial divisions with growth from the throat cell to the channel cell (no x10 jump);
        # convergent wall strips may keep a coarser split than the rest (inlet reversed flow on the fine mesh)
        _ndiv=int(_v.get('nozzle_div') or 0);_nbias=float(_v.get('nozzle_bias') or 0)
        if section=='nozzle' and _ndiv:axial=_ndiv
        _lay_s=int(_v.get('layer_div_convergent') or _lay) if section=='convergent' else _lay
        prefix='Nozzle_' if section=='nozzle' else 'Nozzle_'+section+'_'
        for suffix,group,count in (('axial','_axial_edges',axial),('layers','_layer_edges',_lay_s),('core_radial' if section=='nozzle' else 'radial','_core_radial_edges',_core)):
            name=prefix+suffix;old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)==name];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddSizing()

            if group=='_axial_edges':

                    # same convention as the core radial bias below: small cells at the end of a non-reversed edge;
                    # keep edges that end at the throat (low x), reverse the others

                    o.BiasType=BiasType.NoBias
            if group=='_core_radial_edges':
                o.BiasType=BiasType.ooooo_ooo_o_o;o.BiasOption=BiasOptionType.Factor;o.BiasFactor=100.
                reverse=[]
                for i in o.Location.Ids:
                    e=geo.GeoEntityById(i)
                    vertices=list(e.Vertices)
                    if vertices[0].Y>vertices[-1].Y:reverse.append(i)
                if reverse:
                    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=reverse;o.ReverseBias=info
            record('sizing '+name,{'count':count,'ids':list(o.Location.Ids),'bias':str(o.BiasType)})
    bodies={str(b.Name).split('\\')[-1]:b for a in geo.Assemblies for p in a.Parts for b in p.Bodies}
    gas_edges=set(e.Id for e in bodies['air_dzv'].Edges)
    wallids=sorted(gas_edges.intersection(set(i for n in ('wall_outer-air_dzv','interior-air_dzv-wall_abonite') for i in ns[n].Location.Ids)))
    assert wallids
    old=[n for n in model.NamedSelections.Children if str(n.Name)=='MESH_walls_dzv'];n=old[0] if old else model.AddNamedSelection();n.Name='MESH_walls_dzv'
    info=ExtAPI.SelectionManager.CreateSelectionInfo(SelectionTypeEnum.GeometryEntities);info.Ids=wallids;n.Location=info;n.SendToSolver=False
    old=[o for o in model.Mesh.Children if str(o.Name)=='Inflation_air_dzv'];o=old[0] if old else model.Mesh.AddInflation();o.Name='Inflation_air_dzv';o.NamedSelection=ns['air_dzv'];o.BoundaryNamedSelection=n
    o.InflationOption=1;o.FirstLayerHeight=Quantity('0.0001 [mm]');o.MaximumLayers=20;o.NumberOfLayers=20;o.GrowthRate=1.2
    record('DC inflation configured',{'walls':wallids,'h1_um':.1,'layers':20,'growth':1.2})
    for o in model.Mesh.Children:
        if str(o.Name)=='Core_quadrilateral_method':o.NamedSelection=ns['MESH_core_structured']
    record('setup finished; no mesh generation yet')
except:record('python exception',traceback.format_exc())

# Python Script, API Version = V242
import json,traceback,clr
from System.Reflection import BindingFlags
from System import Array,Object
r={'groups':[]}
try:
    for assembly in ('SpaceClaim','Stored Selection','ScriptingContextContracts'):clr.AddReference(assembly)
    from SpaceClaim import NamedScriptGroupProxyDef
    flags=BindingFlags.Public|BindingFlags.NonPublic|BindingFlags.Instance
    doc=GetRootPart().Document
    inner=doc.GetType().GetField('innerWrapper',flags).GetValue(doc)
    native=inner.GetType().GetProperty('Subject',flags).GetValue(inner,None)
    context=native.GetType().GetProperty('Context',flags).GetValue(native,None)
    code='#V242\n'+open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\geometry_script.py').read()
    definitions=[d for d in native.Definitions if d.GetType().FullName=='SpaceClaim.ScriptExecutionProxyDef']
    for d in definitions:
        proxy=d.GetEvaluation(context)
        proxy.Script=code
        sg=proxy.ScriptGroup
        item={'id':str(d.Id),'group_type':str(sg.GetType()),'before_length':len(sg.Code)}
        sg.ScriptEnvironment.SetApi(242)
        sg.Code=code
        sg.GetType().GetProperty('Latest',flags).SetValue(sg,code,None)
        sg.ScriptEnvironment.GetType().GetMethod('UpdateCode',flags).Invoke(sg.ScriptEnvironment,Array[Object]([code]))
        item['save_result']=str(sg.Save(False))
        proxy.Script=sg.Code
        item['after_length']=len(sg.Code);item['contains_grid']='MESH_core_structured' in sg.Code
        r['groups'].append(item)
    if not r['groups'] or not all(g['contains_grid'] for g in r['groups']):raise ValueError('Published geometry code not updated')
    DocumentSave.Execute(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\g_08_1_files\dp6\SYS-1\DM\SYS-1.scdoc')
    r['saved']=True
except:r['error']=traceback.format_exc()
with open(r'F:\Leontiev_Project\script_persistence_live.json','w') as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)
